recipes.title: Pistachio Kunafa Chocolate Bites
recipes.author: aathirasethumadhavan
recipes.text: 92 kcal per kunafa bite 😋 healthier pistachio kunafa chocolate bites ingredients (makes 10 tbsp sized bites) 1/3 cup raw unsalted pistachios 1/3 cup roasted vermicelli (sevaiyyan or kataifi pastry or filo pastry strips) 1 tsp ghee 4-5 small dates soaked in boiling water for 10 - 15 mins 1/2 cup dark chocolate chips 1 tbsp coconut milk/cream 1 tsp vanilla essence optional- chopped pistachio for garnish method 1. dry roast pistachios until lightly brown and fragrant. let it cool down. 2. fry roasted vermicelli in ghee until it browns a bit. 3. blitz pistachio on a high speed in intervals in the mixie - keep scraping it down - until a smooth pistachio butter forms. 4. add the soaked dates, vanilla and coconut milk and blend until smooth. 5. mix this with the roasted vermicelli. 6. take spoonfuls of this and set on a baking paper. 7. flatten them a bit and freeze for 10-15 mins. 8. melt dark chocolate over a double boiler. 9. coat the kunafa bites with chocolate, sprinkle some chopped pistachio on top, freeze for another 5 mins and done. 10. tastes best when shared. ❤️ .
recipes.caption:
92 Kcal per Kunafa Bite 😋
Healthier Pistachio Kunafa Chocolate Bites 
Ingredients (makes 10 tbsp sized bites)
1/3 cup raw unsalted pistachios
1/3 cup roasted vermicelli (sevaiyyan or kataifi pastry or filo pastry strips)
1 tsp ghee 
4-5 small dates soaked in boiling water for 10 - 15 mins
1/2 cup dark chocolate chips 
1 tbsp coconut milk/cream
1 tsp vanilla essence 
Optional- chopped pistachio for garnish 

Method
1. Dry roast pistachios until lightly brown and fragrant. Let it cool down.
2. Fry roasted vermicelli in ghee until it browns a bit. 
3. Blitz pistachio on a high speed in intervals in the mixie - keep scraping it down - until a smooth pistachio butter forms. 
4. Add the soaked dates, vanilla and coconut milk and blend until smooth.
5. Mix this with the roasted vermicelli.
6. Take spoonfuls of this and set on a baking paper.
7. Flatten them a bit and freeze for 10-15 mins. 
8. Melt dark chocolate over a double boiler.
9. Coat the kunafa bites with chocolate, sprinkle some chopped pistachio on top, freeze for another 5 mins and done. 
10. Tastes best when shared. ❤️

recipes.title: Ragi Chocolate Banana Cake
recipes.author: iamtarneet
recipes.text: ✨ ragi chocolate banana cake ✨ welcome to ep-1 of where i show you how you can make delicious, easy-to-make recipes using millets. toady, we are baking with finger millet (ragi) 😍 1 cup ragi flour (finger millet flour) - 120g 1 cup whole wheat flour - 1 cup (120g) 1/2 cup cocoa powder - 45g 2 large bananas 1/2 cup vegetable oil or melted coconut oil-100g 1/2 cup curd (dahi) - 120g 1 cup sugar (brown, granulated, jaggery powder) - 180g splash of vanilla 1.5 tsp baking powder 1/2 tsp baking soda a pinch of salt 1/2 cup milk (120g) chopped nuts or chocolate chips for garnish * grab a blender jar. add bananas, oil, curd, cocoa powder and vanilla. blend into a smooth paste. keep aside. * in a bowl, add ragi flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder and baking soda. mix well. * add the prepared paste along with milk and fold the batter. * transfer it to a loaf pan, top it up with any nuts of choice and bake at 180 degrees c for 45-50 mins or until a skewer inserted in comes out clean! try this out and let me know if you like it. happy baking ❤️ and what would you like to see for episode 2? let me know in the comments ⬇️ [ragi chocolate cake, baking with millets, eggless baking, chocolate banana cake recipe, ragi cake recipe]
recipes.caption:
✨ Ragi Chocolate Banana Cake ✨

Welcome to Ep-1 of #MilletMagic where I show you how you can make delicious, easy-to-make recipes using millets. Toady, we are baking with Finger Millet (Ragi) 😍

1 cup Ragi flour (finger millet flour) - 120g 
1 cup whole wheat flour - 1 cup (120g)
1/2 cup Cocoa Powder - 45g 
2 large bananas 
1/2 cup vegetable oil or melted coconut oil-100g 
1/2 cup curd (Dahi) - 120g 
1 cup Sugar (brown, granulated, jaggery powder) - 180g 
Splash of vanilla 
1.5 tsp baking powder 
1/2 tsp baking soda 
a pinch of salt 
1/2 cup Milk (120g) 
chopped nuts or chocolate chips for garnish 

* Grab a blender jar. Add bananas, oil, curd, cocoa powder and vanilla. Blend into a smooth paste. Keep aside. 
* In a bowl, add ragi flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder and baking soda. Mix well. 
* Add the prepared paste along with milk and fold the batter. 
* Transfer it to a loaf pan, top it up with any nuts of choice and bake at 180 degrees C for 45-50 mins or until a skewer inserted in comes out clean! 

Try this out and let me know if you like it. Happy baking ❤️

recipes.recipe_method:

Transfer it to a loaf pan, top it up with any nuts of choice and bake at 180 degrees C for 45-50 mins or until a skewer inserted in comes out clean!

recipes.title: Cheesy Veggie Crostini
recipes.author: maxiskitchen
recipes.text: cheesy veggie crostini✨ for the crostini + topping:▪️2 tbsp butter▪️3 cloves garlic▪️1/2 a medium sweet yellow onion, diced small▪️5 mushrooms, chopped▪️1/2 tsp red pepper flakes▪️1 tsp kosher salt▪️1/2 tsp black pepper▪️16 oz. fresh baby spinach▪️1/3 cup italian breadcrumbs▪️1/3 cup shredded mozzarella▪️1/3 cup grated parmesan▪️6 tbsp olive oil▪️1 baguette, sliced in rounds▪️ sprinkle on top: ▪️2/3 cup finely shredded mozzarella▪️1/4 cup grated parmesan▪️ 🌱vegan modification: sub in olive oil for butter, plant based cheese for mozzarella, and nutritional yeast for parmesan 1️⃣ preheat oven to 425f 2️⃣ in a medium pot or large pan, sauté the onions and garlic in butter for 2-3 mins until onions start to become translucent, then add the mushrooms, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper and sauté 2-3 more mins until mushrooms are tender 3️⃣ add the spinach (in batches if you can’t fit it all at once) and sauté until it cooks down (2-3 mins) then mix in the breadcrumbs 4️⃣ transfer into a bowl and let cool while you slice your baguette and cover the bottom of two quarter baking sheets (~9x13”) with 3 tbsp olive oil each 5️⃣ once the veggies have cooled slightly, mix in the mozzarella and parmesan (1/3 cup of each); spread a slightly heaping mound of the veggie topping on each slice of bread and place on the baking sheet 6️⃣ top with finely shredded mozzarella and parmesan and bake 15 mins until bread is golden brown and crispy - enjoy! ⏲15 minute prep time + 25 minute cook time rec

🌱Vegan Modification: Sub in olive oil for butter, plant based cheese for mozzarella, and nutritional yeast for parmesan

3️⃣ Add the spinach (in batches if you can’t fit it all at once) and sauté until it cooks down (2-3 mins) then mix in the breadcrumbs

recipes.text: healthy rice paper egg wrap✨ ▪️avocado or olive oil▪️1 rice paper sheet▪️2 eggs▪️salt & pepper▪️1 scallion, sliced▪️chili oil (optional)▪️cilantro leaves▪️carrot, shaved with a vegetable peeler▪️ 1️⃣ beat eggs with a sprinkle of salt and pepper and set aside 2️⃣ preheat a medium pan over medium heat and coat (or spray) lightly with oil 3️⃣ add a dry rice paper sheet (textured side down) and then add the scallions on top of the rice paper sheet, arranging them so they’re distributed evenly 4️⃣ pour the eggs in the middle of the rice paper sheet and then push them toward the perimeter with chopsticks or a spoon so they fill the sheet in one layer 5️⃣ cook 1-2 mins until the eggs are almost set, then add chili oil to taste and cook for another 1-2 mins until eggs are set (you do not need to flip) 6️⃣ transfer onto a plate and add the cilantro leaves and shaved carrot 7️⃣ eat open face with fork and knife or roll up like a jelly roll and enjoy egg wrap style :) ⏲10 minute total prep + cook time recipe makes one egg wrap
recipes.caption:
Healthy rice paper egg wrap✨

▪️Avocado or Olive Oil▪️1 Rice Paper Sheet▪️2 Eggs▪️Salt & Pepper▪️1 Scallion, sliced▪️Chili Oil (optional)▪️Cilantro Leaves▪️Carrot, shaved with a vegetable peeler▪️

1️⃣ Beat eggs with a sprinkle of salt and pepper and set aside
2️⃣ Preheat a medium pan over medium heat and coat (or spray) lightly with oil
3️⃣ Add a dry rice paper sheet (textured side down) and then add the scallions on top of the rice paper sheet, arranging them so they’re distributed evenly
4️⃣ Pour the eggs in the middle of the rice paper sheet and then push them toward the perimeter with chopsticks or a spoon so they fill the sheet in one layer
5️⃣ Cook 1-2 mins until the eggs are almost set, then add chili oil to taste and cook for another 1-2 mins until eggs are set (you do not need to flip)
6️⃣ Transfer onto a plate and add the cilantro leaves and shaved carrot
7️⃣ Eat open face with fork and knife or roll up like a jelly roll and enjoy egg wrap style :)

⏲10 minute total prep + cook time

Recipe makes one egg wrap
recipes.recipe_ingredients:
Avocado or Olive Oil
1 Rice Paper Sheet
2 Eggs
Salt & Pepper
1 Scallion, sliced
Chili Oil (optional)
Cilantro Leaves
Carrot, shaved with a vegetable peeler
recipes.recipe_method:
Beat eggs with a sprinkle of salt and pepper and set aside
Preheat a medium pan over medium heat and coat (or spray) lightly with oil
Add a dry rice paper sheet (textured side down) and then add the scallions on top of the rice paper sheet, arranging them so they’re distributed evenly
Pour the eggs in the middle of the rice paper sheet and then push them toward the perimeter with chopsticks or a spoon so they fill the sheet in one layer
Cook 1-2 mins until the eggs are almost set, then add chili oil to taste and cook for another 1-2 mins until eggs are set (you do not need to flip)
Transfer onto a plate and add the cilantro leaves and shaved carrot
Eat open face with fork and knife or roll up like a jelly roll and enjoy egg wrap style :)

recipes.title: Lychee Mango Sandesh
recipes.author: snehasinghi1
recipes.text: lychee mango sandesh this amazing dessert uses two of my favourite summer fruits & a few other ingredients. it’s super delicious & comes together in minutes. let’s make this. you can use either vanilla icecream/sugar/sugar-free/stevia (if you're making it for people suffering from diabetes). i made this every year for my grandparents using sugarfree. if your lychee & mango are sweet enough, you can skip the additional sweeteners altogether. 15-20 lychee 100 gms paneer 1 mango, roughly chopped 1 scoop vanilla icecream/ 1/4 cup sugar / 1 tbsp sugar free 8-10 kesar strands soaked in 4-5 tbsp milk 8-10 pistachios, finely chopped make a slit in the lychee & deseed it. mash the paneer well with your palms till smooth. add in the chopped mango, vanilla icecream/sugar & half the kesar soaked in milk. give it a good mix & then stuff the sandesh mixture in the lychee & remove the excess. chill it for 30-40 minutes. arrange in a dish & add in the remaining kesar milk & garnish with chopped pistachios. serve immediately & dig in.!
recipes.caption:
Lychee Mango Sandesh
This amazing dessert uses two of my favourite summer fruits & a few other ingredients. It’s super delicious & comes together in minutes. Let’s make this.

You can use either vanilla icecream/sugar/sugar-free/stevia (if you're making it for people suffering from diabetes). I made this every year for my grandparents using sugarfree. 
If your lychee & mango are sweet enough, you can skip the additional sweeteners altogether.

15-20 lychee
100 gms paneer
1 mango, roughly chopped
1 scoop vanilla icecream/ 1/4 cup sugar / 1 tbsp sugar free
8-10 kesar strands soaked in 4-5 tbsp milk
8-10 pistachios, finely chopped 
Make a slit in the lychee & deseed it. Mash the paneer well with your palms till smooth. Add in the chopped mango, vanilla icecream/sugar & half the kesar soaked in milk. Give it a good mix & then stuff the sandesh mixture in the lychee & remove the excess. Chill it for 30-40 minutes. Arrange in a dish & add in the remaining kesar milk & garnish with chopped pistachios. Serve immediately & dig in.!

15-20 lychee
100 gms paneer
1 mango, roughly chopped
1 scoop vanilla icecream/ 1/4 cup sugar / 1 tbsp sugar free
8-10 kesar strands soaked in 4-5 tbsp milk
8-10 pistachios, finely chopped
recipes.recipe_method: Make a slit in the lychee & deseed it. Mash the paneer well with your palms till smooth. Add in the chopped mango, vanilla icecream/sugar & half the kesar soaked in milk. Give it a good mix & then stuff the sandesh mixture in the lychee & remove the excess. Chill it for 30-40 minutes. Arrange in a dish & add in the remaining kesar milk & garnish with chopped pistachios. Serve immediately & dig in.!

recipes.recipe_method: Mix the bread flour, salt, yeast, and water in a bowl and knead the dough. Ferment the dough overnight in the refrigerator. recipes.author: cassyeungmoney
recipes.text: ✨not too sweet 🥭🍚✨
recipes.caption: ✨not too sweet 🥭🍚✨
recipes.recipe_ingredients:
1 1/2 cups glutinous (sticky) rice
2 cups water
one can Chaokoh coconut milk
1/2 cup sugar
a pinch of salt
cornstarch
mango
toasted sesame seeds
mint
recipes.recipe_method: Cook 1 1/2 cups of glutinous rice with 2 cups of water in a rice cooker. Meanwhile, heat the coconut milk with 1/2 cup sugar and a pinch of salt until dissolved. Reserve about one cup of the coconut mixture for the rice and thicken the remainder with a cornstarch slurry to make a glaze. Transfer the cooked rice to a bowl while hot and mix in the reserved coconut milk until sticky. Plate a molded mound of rice, fan sliced mango on each side, pour the thick glaze over the top, and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and mint.

recipes.text: elevate your morning with fried french toast perfection! 🍳 ingredients: 4 slices of whole-grain bread 1 large egg 1/2 cup/ 120 ml milk (dairy or plant-based) 1 tsp vanilla extract 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon a pinch of salt cooking spray or oil for the air fryer basket 1 cup / 240 g cottage cheese 2 tbsp maple syrup 2 tsp vanilla extract 1/4 cup / 30 g chopped pecans 4 tbsp maple syrup 🧑‍🍳 directions: ◦ preheat your air fryer to 350°f / 180°c. ◦ in a shallow bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, vanilla extract, ground cinnamon, and salt until well combined. ◦ dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, ensuring it’s evenly coated. ◦ lightly grease the air fryer basket or tray with cooking spray or oil. place the bread slices in the air fryer basket, leaving some space between them. ◦ air fry the french toasts for 6-8 minutes, flipping them halfway through the cooking time until they are golden brown and crispy. ◦ meanwhile in a blender or with a hand mixer, combine cottage cheese, 2 tbsp maple syrup, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt until creamy. ◦ remove the air-fried french toast from the air fryer. serve with vanilla cottage cheese cream, chopped pecans, and remaining maple syrup. shop all the ingredients with us & tell us how it turned out. share your experience with us. tag us
recipes.caption:
Elevate Your Morning with Fried French Toast Perfection!

🍳 Ingredients:
4 slices of whole-grain bread
1 large egg
1/2 cup/ 120 ml milk (dairy or plant-based)
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
a pinch of salt
Cooking spray or oil for the air fryer basket
1 cup / 240 g Cottage cheese
2 tbsp maple syrup
2 tsp vanilla extract
1/4 cup / 30 g chopped pecans
4 tbsp maple syrup

🧑‍🍳 Directions:
◦ Preheat your air fryer to 350°F / 180°C.

◦ In a shallow bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, vanilla extract, ground cinnamon, and salt until well combined.

◦ Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, ensuring it’s evenly coated.

◦ Lightly grease the air fryer basket or tray with cooking spray or oil. Place the bread slices in the air fryer basket, leaving some space between them.

◦ Air fry the French toasts for 6-8 minutes, flipping them halfway through the cooking time until they are golden brown and crispy.

◦ Meanwhile in a blender or with a hand mixer, combine cottage cheese, 2 tbsp maple syrup, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt until creamy.

◦ Remove the air-fried French toast from the air fryer. Serve with vanilla cottage cheese cream, chopped pecans, and remaining maple syrup.

recipes.text: mango sago pudding with just four ingredients! this creamy and super-refreshing pudding stars the timeless combination of mangoes and coconuts - with glossy sago pearls (yes, essentially sabudana) for a chewy bite. be sure to use the best quality mangoes for their creamy sweetness! i’m using desai kairi 🥭 from soak 1/2 cup of sabudana/ sago pearls overnight. drain, rinsing well. bring a pot of water to a boil. once simmering, add the sabudana and let it cook until translucent, making sure to stir continuously. remove from heat and immediately drain and rinse with cold water. meanwhile, get yourself a blender jar and add: - 2-4 tbsp condensed milk - 200 ml coconut milk - 1 ripe mango, diced give this a quick blitz until smooth and taste to adjust sweetness if required. add the cooked sago to a bowl with another diced mango. optional: add coconut jelly (if you can find it! pour the mango mixture into this along with a splash more coconut milk (or regular milk is fine too!) mix well to combine , then chill this mixture until it thickens up a bit more. serve fridge-cold and dive in! {mango sago , mango desserts, mango pudding, no bake, summer desserts , quick recipes , four ingredient recipes, easy dessert recipes 🍋 }
recipes.caption:
MANGO SAGO PUDDING with just FOUR INGREDIENTS! 

This creamy and super-refreshing pudding stars the timeless combination of mangoes and coconuts - with glossy sago pearls (yes, essentially sabudana) for a chewy bite. 

Be sure to use the best quality mangoes for their creamy sweetness! I’m using Desai kairi 🥭 from @bloomfieldagro 

Soak 1/2 cup of sabudana/ sago pearls overnight. Drain, rinsing well. 

Bring a pot of water to a boil. Once simmering, add the sabudana and let it cook until translucent, making sure to stir continuously. Remove from heat and immediately drain and rinse with cold water.

Meanwhile, get yourself a blender jar and add:
- 2-4 tbsp condensed milk
- 200 ml coconut milk 
- 1 ripe mango, diced
Give this a quick blitz until smooth and taste to adjust sweetness if required.

Add the cooked sago to a bowl with another diced mango. 
Optional: add coconut jelly (if you can find it!

Pour the mango mixture into this along with a splash more coconut milk (or regular milk is fine too!)

Mix well to combine , then chill this mixture until it thickens up a bit more. Serve fridge-cold and DIVE IN!

2-4 tbsp condensed milk

1 ripe mango, diced
recipes.recipe_method:
Soak 1/2 cup of sabudana/ sago pearls overnight. Drain, rinsing well.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Once simmering, add the sabudana and let it cook until translucent, making sure to stir continuously. Remove from heat and immediately drain and rinse with cold water.
Meanwhile, get yourself a blender jar and add:
- 2-4 tbsp condensed milk
- 200 ml coconut milk
- 1 ripe mango, diced
Give this a quick blitz until smooth and taste to adjust sweetness if required.
Add the cooked sago to a bowl with another diced mango.
Optional: add coconut jelly (if you can find it!
Pour the mango mixture into this along with a splash more coconut milk (or regular milk is fine too!)
Mix well to combine , then chill this mixture until it thickens up a bit more. Serve fridge-cold and DIVE IN!

recipes.title: How to Store Fruit
recipes.author: healthwithcory
recipes.text: 👨‍🍳 the best way to store fruit 🍌 bananas: on the counter wrapped with foil like this, because it helps to stop the release of ethylene gas so the fruit ripens slower and more evenly. 🫐 blueberries- rinse them, dry them and place them in an airtight container in single layers with a paper towel between each layer. this will ensure you minimize moisture buildup as best as possible. 🍇 grapes- soak them for 2 minutes in vinegar, then allow them to dry and store them in an airtight container lined with paper towels in the fridge. 🍅 tomatoes- on the counter upside down, so it creates a small barrier against the oxygen, slowing down the potential growth of mold. 🍎 apple slices- soaking them in a salt water brine for 10 minutes, then drain the water out, rinse them and store in an airtight container in the fridge. 🥒 cucumbers- in a sealed bag with a metal spoon on the top shelf of your fridge, because the spoon helps to alleviate changes in temperature.
recipes.caption:
👨‍🍳 The Best Way To Store Fruit

🍌 Bananas: On the counter wrapped with foil like this, because it helps to stop the release of ethylene gas so the fruit ripens slower and more evenly.

🫐 Blueberries- Rinse them, dry them and place them in an airtight container in single layers with a paper towel between each layer. This will ensure you minimize moisture buildup as best as possible.

🍇 Grapes- Soak them for 2 minutes in vinegar, then allow them to dry and store them in an airtight container lined with paper towels in the fridge.

🍅 Tomatoes- On the counter upside down, so it creates a small barrier against the oxygen, slowing down the potential growth of mold.

🍎 Apple slices- Soaking them in a salt water brine for 10 minutes, then drain the water out, rinse them and store in an airtight container in the fridge.

🥒 Cucumbers- In a sealed bag with a metal spoon on the top shelf of your fridge, because the spoon helps to alleviate changes in temperature.

recipes.title: Chocolate Yogurt Cake
recipes.author: ankitasrivastava9_
recipes.text: 🍰 recipe 👇 1.in a bowl melt chocolate of your choice ( i used one bar of 85% dark chocolate)with 100gms of butter. keep it aside. 2.in a separate bowl mix 250gms greek yogurt with sugar as per taste of your choice. mix it well & add cooled chocolate mix to this. add 1tsp baking powder, 2tbsp cacao powder/cocoa powder & 1 cup of flour …( i used whole wheat) you can use all purpose flour/coconut flour/almond flour as per your liking & make it gf. 3.mix it all well to a consistency shown in the video & transfer it into your cooking vessel. i used air fryer liners here. air fry at 160 for 12 -15 mins. poke the cake with a toothpick & cook it until it comes out clean. 4.let it cool down for 1-2 hours & apply a nice layer of chocolate ganache with some roasted walnuts for crunch & flavour.
recipes.caption:
🍰 RECIPE 👇

1.In a bowl melt chocolate of your choice ( I used one bar of 85% dark chocolate)with 100gms of butter. Keep it aside. 

2.In a separate bowl mix 250gms Greek yogurt with sugar as per taste of your choice. Mix it well & add cooled chocolate mix to this. Add 1tsp baking powder, 2tbsp cacao powder/cocoa powder & 1 cup of flour …( I used whole wheat) you can use all purpose flour/coconut flour/almond flour as per your liking & make it GF. 

3.Mix it all well to a consistency shown in the video & transfer it into your cooking vessel. I used air fryer liners here. Air fry at 160 for 12 -15 mins. Poke the cake with a toothpick & cook it until it comes out clean. 

4.Let it cool down for 1-2 hours & apply a nice layer of chocolate ganache with some roasted walnuts for crunch & flavour.
recipes.recipe_method:
1.In a bowl melt chocolate of your choice ( I used one bar of 85% dark chocolate)with 100gms of butter. Keep it aside.
2.In a separate bowl mix 250gms Greek yogurt with sugar as per taste of your choice. Mix it well & add cooled chocolate mix to this. Add 1tsp baking powder, 2tbsp cacao powder/cocoa powder & 1 cup of flour …( I used whole wheat) you can use all purpose flour/coconut flour/almond flour as per your liking & make it GF.
3.Mix it all well to a consistency shown in the video & transfer it into your cooking vessel. I used air fryer liners here. Air fry at 160 for 12 -15 mins. Poke the cake with a toothpick & cook it until it comes out clean.
4.Let it cool down for 1-2 hours & apply a nice layer of chocolate ganache with some roasted walnuts for crunch & flavour.

recipes.title: Date & Walnut Cake
recipes.author: iamtarneet
recipes.text: ✨ date & walnut cake ✨ hi, i am tarneet 🙋🏻‍♀️ and this is my most viral recipe of 2023 with over 2,000 recreations. you need to give this one a try because it has no maida, no added sugar and is made with whole wheat flour & tastes absolutely divine🥰 25 dates (pitted) (197g) (1 + 1/2 cups) hot milk (375g) 1/2 cup vegetable oil (95g) (you can use melted butter as well) 1 cup whole wheat flour (120g) 1/2 tsp baking powder 1 tsp baking soda 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped) 50gm method: * soak the pitted dates in hot milk for 1 hour so that they become super soft. * then in a bowl, add flour, baking powder and baking soda. whisk well. * then once the dates become soft, blend them into a smooth paste and transfer to a bowl. add in vegetable oil and mix well. * add in your dry ingredients and whisk. * transfer the batter to a 6’inch lined tin, top it up with walnuts and bake at 180 degrees for about 50 mins or until a skewer inserted in comes out clean! try this out and believe me, you won’t believe how tasty can a date cake be! happy baking ❤️❤️❤️ [date and walnut cake, date cake, walnut cake] so, will you try this?
recipes.caption:
✨ Date & Walnut Cake ✨

Hi, I am Tarneet 🙋🏻‍♀️
And this is my most viral recipe of 2023 with over 2,000 recreations. 
You need to give this one a try because it has no Maida, no added sugar and is made with whole wheat flour & tastes absolutely divine🥰

25 Dates (pitted) (197g) 
(1 + 1/2 cups) Hot Milk (375g) 
1/2 cup Vegetable Oil (95g) (you can use melted butter as well) 
1 cup Whole wheat Flour (120g) 
1/2 tsp Baking Powder 
1 tsp Baking Soda 
1/2 cup Walnuts (chopped)  50gm 

Method:
* Soak the pitted dates in Hot milk for 1 hour so that they become super soft. 
* Then in a bowl, add flour, baking powder and baking soda. Whisk well. 
* Then once the dates become soft, blend them into a smooth paste and transfer to a bowl. Add in vegetable oil and mix well. 
* Add in your dry ingredients and whisk. 
* Transfer the batter to a 6’inch lined tin, top it up with walnuts and bake at 180 degrees for about 50 mins or until a skewer inserted in comes out clean! 

Try this out and believe me, you won’t believe how tasty can a Date Cake be! 
Happy baking ❤️❤️❤️

recipes.caption:
It’s always nice to have a comforting traditional recipe like Sabudana Khichdi in the weekly rotation! Be sure to hit save because this is truly fool proof ! Recipe below:

INGREDIENTS
-1.5 cups dry sabudana soaked overnight (*tip below to speed this up)
-2 Thai green chilis, finely diced
-4 tbsp oil
-6 Curry Leaves
-1 tsp cumin seeds
-1 potato, peeled & diced small  
-1 tsp chili powder
-2 tsp sugar
-2 tsp salt
-1/2 lemon juiced
-2 tbsp finely chopped cilantro
-1/2 tsp turmeric powder

DIRECTIONS
-In a large bowl soak the sabudana with 2 cups of water or enough so they are just fully submerged and let this sit covered over night or  4 hours. (If you’re short on time, soak the sabudana in super hot water from a kettle for 30 minutes then replace the hot water as it cools down. Do this until your Sabudana are soft.)

-Make sure the water is fully covering the sabudana. Drain any excess water the next day & set aside.

In a wide non-stick skillet heat oil over medium high heat. Once the oil is hot, add the cumin seeds & green chilis & cook for a few seconds. Add curry leaves then reduce the heat slightly 
And add the potatoes with 1 tsp salt. 

Let the potatoes cook, covered for about 8-10 minutes until completely fork tender, lowering heat and stirring as necessary to prevent burning. 

Once potatoes are cooked are tender add the drained sabudana, chili powder, sugar, lemon juice & remaining salt. Stir well & continue to cook for an additional 4-5 minutes while stirring occasionally. 

Add the cilantro for garnish, mix well & remove from heat. Taste & adjust seasoning as necessary. Favors should be a balance of sweet, spicy & salty. Serve hot!

1 tsp cumin seeds
1 potato, peeled & diced small
1 tsp chili powder
2 tsp sugar
2 tsp salt
1/2 lemon juiced
2 tbsp finely chopped cilantro
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
recipes.recipe_method:
In a large bowl soak the sabudana with 2 cups of water or enough so they are just fully submerged and let this sit covered over night or 4 hours. (If you’re short on time, soak the sabudana in super hot water from a kettle for 30 minutes then replace the hot water as it cools down. Do this until your Sabudana are soft.)
Make sure the water is fully covering the sabudana. Drain any excess water the next day & set aside.
In a wide non-stick skillet heat oil over medium high heat. Once the oil is hot, add the cumin seeds & green chilis & cook for a few seconds. Add curry leaves then reduce the heat slightly And add the potatoes with 1 tsp salt.
Let the potatoes cook, covered for about 8-10 minutes until completely fork tender, lowering heat and stirring as necessary to prevent burning.
Once potatoes are cooked are tender add the drained sabudana, chili powder, sugar, lemon juice & remaining salt. Stir well & continue to cook for an additional 4-5 minutes while stirring occasionally.
Add the cilantro for garnish, mix well & remove from heat. Taste & adjust seasoning as necessary. Favors should be a balance of sweet, spicy & salty. Serve hot!

recipes.text: raw mango rassam now this is something that i'm sure you'll love. it's tangy, sweet, spicy & absolutely refreshing. let's make this. 2 raw mangoes 1 inch of ginger 2 green chillies 2 garlic cloves 2 cups water or more 2 tbsp jaggery powder or more 1 tsp pepper 1 onion, sliced salt to taste 1 tsp black salt 1 tbsp oil 1 tbsp mustard seeds 2 dried red chillies 15-20 curry leaves roast the raw mango, ginger, garlic, green chillies on open flame till charred & cooked through. peel the mangoes & chop them roughly. peel the ginger too. now, blitz this to a smooth puree with some water. add the puree to a bowl alongwith jaggery, pepper, onion, salt & black salt. mix this well. for the tempering, heat a pan & add in the oil. add mustard seeds, dried red chillies & curry leaves & let it pop. pour the tempering over the rasam. serve with rice or as is & dig in.! wearing
recipes.caption:
Raw Mango Rassam
Now this is something that I'm sure you'll love. It's tangy, sweet, spicy & absolutely refreshing. Let's make this. 

2 raw mangoes
1 inch of ginger 
2 green chillies 
2 garlic cloves
2 cups water or more 
2 tbsp jaggery powder or more 
1 tsp pepper
1 onion, sliced 
Salt to taste 
1 tsp black salt
1 tbsp oil
1 tbsp mustard seeds 
2 dried red chillies 
15-20 curry leaves
Roast the raw mango, ginger, garlic, green chillies on open flame till charred & cooked through. Peel the mangoes & chop them roughly. Peel the ginger too. Now, blitz this to a smooth puree with some water. Add the puree to a bowl alongwith jaggery, pepper, onion, salt & black salt. Mix this well. For the tempering, heat a pan & add in the oil. Add mustard seeds, dried red chillies & curry leaves & let it pop. Pour the tempering over the rasam. Serve with rice or as is & dig in.!

recipes.caption:
@shredhappens HIGH PROTEIN EGG SALAD

This is a double dose of protein - instead of mayo, I used cottage cheese and this is just about the most filling egg salad you’ll ever have. Its bursting with flavors, textures, and really keeps you satiated. Ingredients and full recipe below.

Ingredients: 
4 Eggs
Fresh Cilantro - 1/3 cup, finely chopped
Fresh Mint - small handful, chopped
1/3 cup Red Onion, diced
1/2 cup Cottage Cheese
2 tbsp Dijon Mustard 
1/2 cup pickled Jalapeños or Pickles, finely chopped
1-2 tbsp Salsa Mocha, Garlic Chili Crisp, or Sriracha
1-2 tsp chipotle powder
Salt and Pepper to taste

1. Boil 4 eggs. I bring a pot of water to a boil, add in eggs, and boil for 8-9 minutes.
2. Peel the eggs, and use a grater to grate them into a large mixing bowl.
3. In the bowl add 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro and small handful of fresh chopped fresh mint, 1/3 diced red onion.
4. Instead of mayo, I used 1/2 cup cottage cheese (you can blend/process the cottage cheese if you wish to get rid of the curds),add 2 tbsp dijon mustard, 
5. I like to add some pickled cucumbers or jalapeños, so I finally chopped 1/2 cup pickled jalapeños (you can use pickles, too), then for some more spice added 1 to 2 tbsp of salsa mocha or garlic chili crisp. If you dont have it, sriracha would work fine as a sub.
6. Finally, season with a pinch or two of salt, 1 tsp to 2 tsp chipotle powder, and some fresh cracked pepper.
7. Give it a really good mix, taste, and adjust however way you wish
8. I topped a lowcarb cracker with a few tablespoons, added avocado, and some more salsa mocha.

This is SO good.

.
.

recipes.text: sprouted moong palak pulao 💚 this moong sprout palak pulao recipe is one of my favorite healthy go-to meal options for busy days. whole spices like cumin, cardamom, bay leaves, cloves and cinnamon go in that provide a nice earthiness and heat to the puloa. let’s see the recipe. ingredients 1 tsp ghee 1 bay leaf 1 cinnamon stick 2 cloves 2 green cardamom 1 tsp cumin seeds 2 green chillies 1/2 tsp ginger 1 cup palak/ spinach 3/4 cup sprouted moong 1 cup basmati rice 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper powder 1/2 tsp cumin powder 3-4 lemon slices 2.5 cups water 1 tsp lemon juice fresh coriander leaves roasted peanuts method 1. in a pan add ghee and whole spices, when the aroma starts coming out, add ginger, green chillies along with palak and saute for 3-4 mins 2. now add sprouted moong and saute again for a min or 2 3. now add in rice, salt, cumin powder and black pepper powder, mix. add water and lemon slices and cover the pan 4. cook it for 10-15 mins on low heat 5. remove the lid and discard lemon slices 6. add lemon juice, coriander leaves and roasted peanuts 7. enjoy hot with a bowl of curd or chutney :)
recipes.caption:
Sprouted moong Palak pulao 💚

This Moong sprout Palak Pulao recipe is one of my favorite healthy go-to meal options for busy days. Whole spices like cumin, cardamom, bay leaves, cloves and cinnamon go in that provide a nice earthiness and heat to the puloa.  Let’s see the recipe.

Ingredients 
1 tsp ghee
1 bay leaf
1 cinnamon stick
2 cloves
2 green cardamom 
1 tsp cumin seeds
2 green chillies
1/2 tsp ginger 
1 cup Palak/ spinach
3/4 cup sprouted moong 
1 cup basmati rice
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp black pepper powder
1/2 tsp cumin powder
3-4 lemon slices
2.5 cups water
1 tsp lemon juice
Fresh coriander leaves
Roasted peanuts

Method
1. In a pan add ghee and whole spices, when the aroma starts coming out, add ginger, green chillies along with Palak and saute for 3-4 mins
2. Now add sprouted moong and saute again for a min or 2
3. Now add in rice, salt, cumin powder and black pepper powder, mix. Add water and lemon slices and cover the pan
4. Cook it for 10-15 mins on low heat
5. Remove the lid and discard lemon slices
6. Add lemon juice, coriander leaves and roasted peanuts 
7. Enjoy hot with a bowl of curd or chutney :)

recipes.title: Maple Syrup Banana Tarte Tatin
recipes.author: plant_based.recipes
recipes.text: maple syrup banana tarte tatin recipe 🥐 by save this super easy dessert recipe and send it to a sweet tooth! ingredients: 4 bananas 1/4 cup maple syrup 1/2 tsp sea salt flakes 1 puff pastry sheet - thawed 1 tbsp vegan melted butter method: preheat oven to 200c pour the maple syrup into an approx 24cm oven safe pan then sprinkle with the sea salt slice the bananas in half then lay them flat side down in the pan cut the puff pastry into a circle and place that over the bananas. gently pat it down to seal it. brush the melted butter on top and then bake in the oven for 15 minutes when removing the pan from the oven, don’t be like me and forget (twice) that the handle is super hot lay baking paper over the tarte, then a board as seen in the video, and flip over to reveal caramelised banana! serve with cream or ice cream and a sprinkle of icing sugar and enjoy ❤️
recipes.caption:
Maple Syrup Banana Tarte Tatin Recipe 🥐

By @Sezzy.brown

Save this super easy dessert recipe and send it to a sweet tooth!

Ingredients:

4 bananas
1/4 cup maple syrup
1/2 tsp sea salt flakes
1 puff pastry sheet - thawed
1 tbsp vegan melted butter

Method:

Preheat oven to 200C

Pour the maple syrup into an approx 24cm oven safe pan then sprinkle with the sea salt

Slice the bananas in half then lay them flat side down in the pan

Cut the puff pastry into a circle and place that over the bananas. Gently pat it down to seal it.

Brush the melted butter on top and then bake in the oven for 15 minutes

When removing the pan from the oven, don’t be like me and forget (twice) that the handle is super hot

Lay baking paper over the tarte, then a board as seen in the video, and flip over to reveal caramelised banana!

Serve with cream or ice cream and a sprinkle of icing sugar and enjoy ❤️

recipes.title: Chia Pudding
recipes.author: theplantcollective_
recipes.text: if you’ve been following me awhile, you probably already know how much i love my chia pudding 💙 here are my tips in making the best chia pudding possible: 💙 use a combo of yogurt and milk for texture and flavor. i use soy milk because it only has 1 ingredient and is packed with complete plant protein. for yogurt i use vanilla bean yogurt because it has probiotics and just tastes insanely delicious! 💛 use a high quality protein. i love protein powders, they have a ton of flavors and are made with natural ingredients. 💚 use this ratio - 2 tbsp chia seeds, 1/2 cup milk, 3-4 tbsp yogurt, 1 tbsp sugar. stir and let sit overnight. 🤎 top with your favorite combo of nuts, seeds, and fruits. i’ll use whatever fresh fruit i meal prepped/washed that week with hemp seeds and some type of nut - walnuts, slivered almonds, brazil nuts, nut butter, etc 🧡 eat your chia pudding slowly, especially if you’re a beginner. chia seeds help to reduce the bad bacteria and increase good bacteria in the gut, contain lots of fiber, & support healthier bowel movements. you’ll likely have to use the bathroom soon after eating fyi! 🩷 as yummy as chia pudding is, i don’t eat it every day. eating the same foods everyday can lead to intolerance, plus to obtain a healthy gut you need to eat as diverse a diet as possible. enjoy, and to prep some chia pudding!!!
recipes.caption:
If you’ve been following me awhile, you probably already know how much I love my chia pudding 💙 

Here are my tips in making the BEST chia pudding possible:

💙 Use a combo of yogurt and milk for texture and flavor. I use @edenfoods soy milk because it only has 1 ingredient and is packed with complete plant protein. For yogurt I use @foragerproject vanilla bean yogurt because it has probiotics and just tastes insanely delicious! 

💛 Use a high quality protein. I love @sproutliving protein powders, they have a ton of flavors and are made with natural ingredients.

💚 Use this ratio - 2 tbsp chia seeds, 1/2 cup milk, 3-4 tbsp yogurt, 1 tbsp sugar. Stir and let sit overnight. 

🤎 Top with your favorite combo of nuts, seeds, and fruits. I’ll use whatever fresh fruit I meal prepped/washed that week with hemp seeds and some type of nut - walnuts, slivered almonds, brazil nuts, nut butter, etc

🧡 Eat your chia pudding slowly, especially if you’re a beginner. Chia seeds help to reduce the bad bacteria and increase good bacteria in the gut, contain lots of fiber, & support healthier bowel movements. You’ll likely have to use the bathroom soon after eating FYI!

🩷 As yummy as chia pudding is, I don’t eat it every day. Eating the same foods everyday can lead to intolerance, plus to obtain a healthy gut you need to eat as diverse a diet as possible. 

Enjoy, and to prep some chia pudding!!!

recipes.text: mango sago with nata de coco, aka mango bango is such a refreshing and delicious dessert. this time, i added ube extract today for a little pop of color. strawberries or frozen mango are also great for this recipe! here’s what i used for this recipe: 2 cups mangos (2 large mangos) 3/4 cup sago 1 tsp ube extract (optional) 1 jar nata de coco (coconut jellies) 1 14 oz can coconut milk 1 cup half and half (half milk/half cream mixture) 1/3 cup condensed milk boil 3 cups water in a pot then add sago and ube extract. cook only medium heat for 10 minutes, then remove from heat and cover with a lid for 15 minutes. drain and rinse under cold water. cut the mangos into cubes and place in large bowl. add the sago to the bowl along with the coconut jellies (drain out half of the syrup), coconut milk, half and half and condensed milk. mix to combine then refrigerate for 2-4 hours before serving.
recipes.caption:

1 tsp ube extract (optional)
1 jar Nata de Coco (coconut jellies)

Cut the mangos into cubes and place in large bowl. Add the sago to the bowl along with the coconut jellies (drain out half of the syrup), coconut milk, half and half and condensed milk. Mix to combine then refrigerate for 2-4 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Jeow Som Dipping Sauce
recipes.author: johnnymorilloo
recipes.text: jeow som (many may know it as crack dipping sauce) *it’s laos and not lao, lao is the people. apologies in advance* this recipe was so unreal, it was so simple to make and you can easily customise it to your own palette. even though there were chillis, it’s hidden from the taste of the fish sauce and brown sugar. give this one a go and let me know what you think :) you can partner this with whatever your heart desires from proteins, grains, noodles, spring rolls, summer rolls, gyoza and much more ingredients - 1/4 - 1/2 cup fish sauce (ve) - 1 shallot, chopped - 4-5 garlic cloves - 2-3 thai chilli - handful of coriander - 1 juice of a lime - 1 tbsp brown sugar (or cane sugar) - 1 tsp salt - (optional) 1 tsp msg & no it’s not bad for you!!! method 1. using a food processor add shallots, garlic, chilli, coriander, brown sugar & salt, let this blend for 10-20 seconds 2. in a large bowl, combine all your ingredients and add the fish sauce. let this set aside from 20 minutes. allowing all the flavours to mix nicely :) 3. store in the fridge for 2-3 weeks, top it up with extra fish sauce
recipes.caption:
Jeow Som (many may know it as crack dipping sauce)

*It’s Laos and not Lao, Lao is the people. Apologies in advance*

This recipe was so unreal, it was so simple to make and you can easily customise it to your own palette. Even though there were chillis, it’s hidden from the taste of the fish sauce and brown sugar. 

Give this one a go and let me know what you think :) you can partner this with whatever your heart desires from proteins, grains, noodles, spring rolls, summer rolls, gyoza and much more 

Ingredients
- 1/4 - 1/2 cup fish sauce (ve)
- 1 shallot, chopped 
- 4-5 garlic cloves
- 2-3 Thai chilli 
- Handful of coriander 
- 1 juice of a lime
- 1 tbsp brown sugar (or cane sugar)
- 1 tsp Salt
- (optional) 1 tsp MSG & NO IT’S NOT BAD FOR YOU!!!

Method
1. Using a food processor add shallots, garlic, chilli, coriander, brown sugar & salt, let this blend for 10-20 seconds
2. In a large bowl, combine all your ingredients and add the fish sauce. Let this set aside from 20 minutes. Allowing all the flavours to mix nicely :) 
3. Store in the fridge for 2-3 weeks, top it up with extra fish sauce

recipes.title: Sannata Raita
recipes.author: thespicystory
recipes.text: this sannata raita 🪔 😍 is popular in up/bihar and is said to quite all your stomach problems in one go. the use of diya for tadka gives it a unique earthy flavour, which makes it even more delicious. try it and you will make this sannata/sarrata raita again and again. ingredients - 1 cup curd/yogurt, little sour is preferred 2-1/2 cups water or more, adjustable salt, to taste 1/2 tsp black salt 1/2 tsp red chilli powder 1/2 tsp cumin powder 3-4 tbsp boondi 1 tbsp coriander, finely chopped for tadka - 1 tsp mustard oil 1/2 tsp cumin seeds 1 dry red chillies, broken 1 green chilli, chopped 1/4 tap hing instructions - add yogurt, water in a bowl and whisk it well. you can use buttermilk too if you need watery raita. add salt, black salt, red chilli powder, cumin powder and mix it well. heat a diya. add oil and heat it up. add hing, cumin seeds, dry red chillies and cook for a few seconds. add green chillies and add the diya in the yogurt mix, mix well and let it rest for 2-3 mins. take out the diya, add boondi, coriander and mix it well. serve with aloo ki sabzi and hot hot pooris.
recipes.caption:
This Sannata Raita 🪔 😍 is popular in UP/Bihar and is said to quite all your stomach problems in one go. The use of diya for tadka gives it a unique earthy flavour, which makes it even more delicious. Try it and you will make this sannata/sarrata raita again and again. 

Ingredients -
1 cup curd/yogurt, little sour is preferred 
2-1/2 cups water or more, adjustable
Salt, to taste 
1/2 tsp black salt
1/2 tsp red chilli powder 
1/2 tsp cumin powder
3-4 tbsp boondi
1 tbsp coriander, finely chopped 
For tadka -
1 tsp mustard oil
1/2 tsp cumin seeds 
1 dry red chillies, broken
1 green chilli, chopped
1/4 tap hing

Instructions -
Add yogurt, water in a bowl and whisk it well. You can use buttermilk too if you need watery raita. Add salt, black salt, red chilli powder, cumin powder and mix it well. 
Heat a diya. Add oil and heat it up. Add hing, cumin seeds, dry red chillies and cook for a few seconds. Add green chillies and add the diya in the yogurt mix, mix well and let it rest for 2-3 mins. 
Take out the diya, add boondi, coriander and mix it well. Serve with aloo ki sabzi and hot hot pooris.

recipes.text: makhana (foxnut ) raita - a flavorful fusion with health-boosting benefits! delectable way to add protein and fiber to your plate! ingredients:- - 1 cup makhana (fox nuts or lotus seeds) - 1 cup curd (yogurt) - 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds - 1/4 teaspoon hing (asafoetida) (optional) - 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder - 1/2 teaspoon chaat masala - 1/2 teaspoon black salt - salt, to taste - 1/4 teaspoon black pepper - coriander leaves, for garnishing - 1 teaspoon jaggery (optional, for sweetness) instructions:- 1. dry roast the makhana in a pan until they become crispy. 2. whisk the curd until smooth in a mixing bowl. add cumin powder, chaat masala, black salt, regular salt, hing and black pepper according to taste. mix everything well. 3. optionally, add a teaspoon of jaggery for a hint of sweetness. 4. add pomegranate seeds to the mixture for a burst of flavor and color. 5. add the roasted makhana to the curd. 6. garnish with fresh coriander leaves & pomegranate seeds . 7. chill the makhana raita in the refrigerator for some time before serving. 8. serve cold as a refreshing and healthy accompaniment to your meal! enjoy by delicious and nutritious makhana raita 🌱 . .

recipes.title: Stuffed Mirapakaya
recipes.author: appadam.of.my.eye
recipes.text: story time about why those ‘tanku’ mirapakays: my mom went to the store to purchase bajji mirapakays but this is all that they had 😂 so she bought them anyway - and ammamma being ammama was like hey intha size lo unay - why dont we stuff them! recipe below (not exact): . for the stuffing: - boiled potatoes, grated carrots, mixed in with some salt, ginger paste, finely cut chili and a powder of ajwain&cumin seeds in appropriate quantities- . for the batter: -1/2 cup besan flour, 1 tbsp plus a little rice flour, salt, karam to taste, a little bit of that ajwain+cumin powder, water . for the peppers, -obviously, thinner the pepper/skin of the pepper, better the taste, if you do use poblano peppers- when cut horizontally in half, the bottom halves taste really good when fried versus the top- but if you want to use the top- cut it again in half so it looks more like a bajji cross section than a whole:) also- this is optional, but if the pepper is too thick, roasting it first helps breakdown the skin and can cut the frying time by a little! . cut the peppers in half, roast if necessary, cut a vertical slit, coat the inside with a sprinkling of besan, stuff the curry, close it up, (optional: coat the outside with some curry too), dip in besan batter and fry on low heat till golden brown! . [telugu cooking, fried, mirchi bajji, new recipe, cooking with your grandmom]
recipes.caption:
Story time about why those ‘tanku’ mirapakays: my mom went to the store to purchase bajji mirapakays but this is all that they had 😂 so she bought them anyway - and ammamma being ammama was like hey intha size lo unay - why dont we stuff them! Recipe below (not exact):
.
For the stuffing:
- boiled potatoes, grated carrots, mixed in with some salt, ginger paste, finely cut chili and a powder of ajwain&cumin seeds in appropriate quantities- 
.
For the batter:
-1/2 cup besan flour, 1 tbsp plus a little rice flour, salt, karam to taste, a little bit of that ajwain+cumin powder, water 
.
For the Peppers,
-obviously, thinner the pepper/skin of the pepper, better the taste, if you do use Poblano peppers- when cut horizontally in half, the bottom halves taste really good when fried versus the top- but if you want to use the top- cut it again in half so it looks more like a bajji cross section than a whole:) also- this is optional, but if the pepper is too thick, roasting it first helps breakdown the skin and can cut the frying time by a little!
.
Cut the peppers in half, roast if necessary, cut a vertical slit, coat the inside with a sprinkling of besan, stuff the curry, close it up, (optional: coat the outside with some curry too), dip in besan batter and fry on low heat till golden brown!
.

recipes.title: Moong Dal with Orange
recipes.author: keertidacooks
recipes.text: moong dal with oranges given we have just a few more weeks left of nagpur santra season, hurry and make this really special dal that i came across in pumpkin flower fritters, a beautiful cookbook by renuka devi. here are my proportions, adjusted and adapted from the original recipe 1/3 cup/ 75 gms of moong dal, roasted once cool, wash and pressure cook with just enough water. once cooked, mash- keep it as chunky/ smooth as you like. while the dal is cooking, prepare the orange- peel, remove membranes and seeds of 1 orange- keeping the segments as intact as possible. also reserve some peel (about 1/8th of an orange- too much will make it bitter) and cut it into thin strips now in a pot, heat 1 tbsp ghee and temper it with 1/2 tsp sugar- let this begin to caramelise and then quickly add ginger, julienned/ cut into strips 1 bay leaf garam masala made by grinding 1/2 inch stick of cinnamon and seeds from 1-2 cardamom 1/4 tsp turmeric powder + 1/4 tsp red chili powder, diluted with 2 tsp water stir everything well, now tip in the cooked and mashed dal add water, along with salt, to taste 2 green chilies, slit sugar, to taste/ optional (we already have sugar in the tempering) once the dal comes to a simmer, carefully add orange segments + the peel cut into strips and turn off heat. cover and let it sit for 10 mins. serve with hot rice- and take in the surprising joy of fishing out juicy orange segments from your dal.
recipes.caption:
Moong dal with oranges

Given we have just a few more weeks left of Nagpur Santra season, hurry and make this really special dal that I came across in Pumpkin Flower Fritters, a beautiful cookbook by Renuka Devi.

Here are my proportions, adjusted and adapted from the original recipe

1/3 cup/ 75 gms of moong dal, roasted 

Once cool, wash and pressure cook with just enough water.
Once cooked, mash- keep it as chunky/ smooth as you like.

While the dal is cooking, prepare the orange- peel, remove membranes and seeds of 1 orange- keeping the segments as intact as possible. Also reserve some peel (about 1/8th of an orange- too much will make it bitter) and cut it into thin strips 

Now

In a pot, heat 
1 Tbsp ghee and temper it with 
1/2 tsp sugar- let this begin to caramelise and then quickly add 
Ginger, julienned/ cut into strips 
1 bay leaf
Garam masala made by grinding 1/2 inch stick of cinnamon and seeds from 1-2 cardamom
1/4 tsp turmeric powder + 1/4 tsp red chili powder, diluted with 2 tsp water 

Stir everything well, now tip in the cooked and mashed dal 

Add water, along with 
Salt, to taste
2 green chilies, slit 
Sugar, to taste/ optional (we already have sugar in the tempering)

Once the dal comes to a simmer, carefully add orange segments + the peel cut into strips and turn off heat.

Cover and let it sit for 10 mins.

Serve with hot rice- and take in the surprising joy of fishing out juicy orange segments from your dal.

While the dal is cooking, prepare the orange- peel, remove membranes and seeds of 1 orange- keeping the segments as intact as possible. Also reserve some peel (about 1/8th of an orange- too much will make it bitter) and cut it into thin strips
Now
In a pot, heat
1 Tbsp ghee and temper it with
1/2 tsp sugar- let this begin to caramelise and then quickly add
Ginger, julienned/ cut into strips
1 bay leaf
Garam masala made by grinding 1/2 inch stick of cinnamon and seeds from 1-2 cardamom
1/4 tsp turmeric powder + 1/4 tsp red chili powder, diluted with 2 tsp water
Stir everything well, now tip in the cooked and mashed dal
Add water, along with

recipes.title: Vankaya Pandu Mirchi Pachadi
recipes.author: extraachutney
recipes.text: vankaya pandu mirchi pachadi ingredients: 1 brinjal (large) 3 red serrano peppers or 8 pandu mirchis 4-5 green chillies 6-7 garlic 2 tbsp peanut oil 1 medium tomato 1 tbsp chilli powder 1 tbsp salt for tadka: 1 tsp oil 1 tsp jeera and mustard seeds 1 tsp chana and urad dal 4-5 curry leaves heat oil in a pan, add the garlic and chopped brinjal, let it roast well in oil, add red and green chillies mix well. immediately add the tomato and mix well. cover and cook for 2 minutes. mix and cook again until the tomato is well cooked. add chilli powder and salt. mix well and turn the flame off in 1 minute. you can then grind this to a chutney in a mortat pestle, grinder (on pulse mode) or use an immersion blender like i did. don’t blend it too much, coarse texture is what brings taste to this pachadi. telugu recipes | pachadi recipes | chutney recipes | brinjal chutney
recipes.caption:
Vankaya pandu mirchi pachadi

Ingredients:

1 brinjal (large)
3 red serrano peppers or 8 pandu mirchis
4-5 green chillies
6-7 garlic 
2 tbsp peanut oil
1 medium tomato
1 tbsp chilli powder
1 tbsp salt 

For tadka:
1 tsp oil
1 tsp jeera and mustard seeds
1 tsp chana and urad dal
4-5 curry leaves 

Heat oil in a pan, add the garlic and chopped brinjal, let it roast well in oil, add red and green chillies mix well. Immediately add the tomato and mix well. Cover and cook for 2 minutes. Mix and cook again until the tomato is well cooked. Add chilli powder and salt. Mix well and turn the flame off in 1 minute.

You can then grind this to a chutney in a mortat pestle, grinder (on pulse mode) or use an immersion blender like I did. Don’t blend it too much, coarse texture is what brings taste to this pachadi.

recipes.text: garlic fried rice 3 beaten eggs neutral oil for frying 5 tbsp of salted butter 6 cloves of chopped garlic 4 chopped spring onions whites separate to the green 1 tsp or more of sesame seeds 1 tsp of sesame oil 2 cups of any rice. i used the trader joe’s brown rice it’s my favorite. but basmati also works great. ideally should be short grain seasonings: 1/2 tsp of salt, 1/2 tsp of white sugar, 1 tsp of chicken powder i use the brand 2 tbsp of soy sauce in a frying pan over medium heat scramble the eggs. remove from pan. return the pan back to the heat and place the heat on high. add 2 tablespoons of butter and a little bit of oil. when the butter gets warmed up add the garlic and the whites of the green onions. once the garlic gets fragrant and golden add in the sesame seeds and the rice and 2 more tbsp of butter. once the butter melts add in the seasonings as well as the soy sauce. mix well, adjust seasoning. pour the sesame oil and add another tbsp of butter right before serving. top with green spring onions and serve immediately. come back tomorrow for the fish teppenyaki recipe that goes great with this rice.

recipes.text: crispy smashed harissa potatoes on a thick garlicky yoghurt, topped with pickled onions and parsley. this was addictive!! ingredients: 500g baby potatoes 1 heaped tbsp harissa paste 3-4 tbsp olive oil salt yoghurt: 1 small clove garlic 1/2 a lemon 3 heaped tbsp greek yoghurt salt parsley and pickled onions(recipe in highlights) to serves method: preheat the oven to 200c. par boil the potatoes until just soft, drain and then smush with a glass. mix the harissa and oil together and then pour this on top and mix. roast in the oven for another 35-40 minutes until crisp around the edges. meanwhile, mix minced garlic with lemon juice and salt in a bowl, leave for 5 minutes and then stir through the yoghurt. spread it on a plate and top with the crispy pots, pickled onions and parsley
recipes.caption:
Crispy smashed harissa potatoes on a thick garlicky yoghurt, topped with pickled onions and parsley. This was addictive!! 

Ingredients:
500g baby potatoes 
1 heaped tbsp harissa paste 
3-4 tbsp olive oil 
Salt 

Yoghurt:
1 small clove garlic 
1/2 a lemon 
3 heaped tbsp greek yoghurt 
Salt 

Parsley and Pickled onions(recipe in highlights) to serves

Method:
Preheat the oven to 200C. Par boil the potatoes until just soft, drain and then smush with a glass. Mix the harissa and oil together and then pour this on top and mix. Roast in the oven for another 35-40 minutes until crisp around the edges. 

Meanwhile, mix minced garlic with lemon juice and salt in a bowl, leave for 5 minutes and then stir through the yoghurt. Spread it on a plate and top with the crispy pots, pickled onions and parsley

recipes.title: Ulli Kadala Chutney
recipes.author: extraachutney
recipes.text: ulli kadala chutney: ingredients: 1 bunch spring onion (5-6 individual stalks) 1 tbsp peanut oil 1tsp jeera 4-5 green chillies (or more if you want it to be extra spicy) 1 small marble sized ball of tamarind 1 tsp turmeric powder 5 cloves of garlic 1/2 cup cilantro 1 tsp corriander powder 1 tsp salt - heat oil in a pan, add jeera, garlic, green chillies and roast well. then add tamarind and turmeric powder and mix. - add chopped spring onions and mix well - immediately add cilantro and mix well - add salt and corriander powder and let this cook for 3-4 minutes - now add 1tbsp water (only if it got too dry), close lid and let it cook for a minute. - turn the stove off and transfer the mixture into a mortar pestle after it cools down - alternatively you can use a grinder to pulse grind - mash into a chutney and enjoy with hot rice and ghee/peanut oil telugu pachadi recipes | chutney reels | spring onion chutney | scallion chutney | scallion recipes | spring onion recipes | chutney recipes
recipes.caption:
Ulli kadala chutney:

Ingredients:
1 bunch spring onion (5-6 individual stalks)
1 tbsp peanut oil
1tsp jeera
4-5 green chillies (or more if you want it to be extra spicy)
1 small marble sized ball of tamarind
1 tsp turmeric powder
5 cloves of garlic
1/2 cup cilantro
1 tsp corriander powder
1 tsp salt

- Heat oil in a pan, add jeera, garlic, green chillies and roast well. Then add tamarind and turmeric powder and mix.
- Add chopped spring onions and mix well
- Immediately add cilantro and mix well
- Add salt and corriander powder and let this cook for 3-4 minutes 
- Now add 1tbsp water (only if it got too dry), close lid and let it cook for a minute.
- Turn the stove off and transfer the mixture into a mortar pestle after it cools down
- Alternatively you can use a grinder to pulse grind
- Mash into a chutney and enjoy with hot rice and ghee/peanut oil

recipes.recipe_ingredients:
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery ribs
2 garlic cloves, quartered
salt, to taste
pepper, to taste
5 cups cauliflower, small head
3 potatoes, peeled and quartered
4 cups chicken broth
2 cups water
chives + bacon bits for presentation are optional
recipes.recipe_method:
In a big pot on the stove on medium high heat add olive oil and add the onions.
You do not need to dice anything finely because everything will be puréed at the end.
Add the carrots, celery, garlic and sauté for a few minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and stir again. Add the cauliflower florets and potatoes.
Cover with enough stock and water and put just enough to cover the veggies. Let it come to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and partially cover it with a lid, let it cook for 25 to 30 minutes or until the veggies are soft.
Once the soup is done, you can use a stick blender to blend until smooth. You can also blend the veggies with the stock in batches in a blender if you don’t own an immersion blender.
If blending with a blender, pour the creamy soup back in to the pot and taste for salt. Serve with bacon bits and chives.

recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice
recipes.author: groovyfoodiess
recipes.text: mango sticky rice 🥭🇹🇭 (my version of khao neeo mamuang) 1. cook 1 cup sticky rice to 1.1 cup water in rice cooker 2. slice mangos 3. make coconut sauce, which is 1 cup coconut milk and 1/2 cup sugar +1 tsp salt and adjust to desired sweetness 4. once rice is done, add about 1/4 of the coconut mixture and gently mix into the rice. 5. add about 3 tbsp corn starch slurry (2 tbsp corn starch + 1 tbsp water, mixed in a bowl) into the coconut milk and stir until thickkkkyyy 6. plate and garnish with toasted sesame seeds!

recipes.title: Kashmiri Chai
recipes.author: thenewyorknest
recipes.text: let’s make kashmiri chai together, a milk tea made from green tea leaves that naturally turns pink when made with the secret ingredient i call, patience 🤲🏼💗☕️🫖⁣ ⁣ recipe ⁣ cinnamon stick (1)⁣ star anise (1-2)⁣ cardamom pods (handful)⁣ loose green tea leaves (half cup)⁣ milk (2 cups) ⁣ sugar (per your liking)⁣ salt (dash) ⁣ baking soda (1.5 teaspoons) ⁣ ⁣ 🌸place cinnamon stick, star anise, cardamom and green tea leaves in 3 cups of water. ⁣ ⁣ 🌸bring to boil approximately 2-3 times. aerate/whisk the liquid so much that it evaporates and reduces to one cup, then add ice 🧊 cold water to replace the evaporated water. ⁣ ⁣ 🌸add baking soda, and a pinch of salt. allow that to boil for approximately 15-25 mins on medium heat, if water reduces, keep adding more cold water to replenish. ⁣ ⁣ 🌸after a while, the liquid should start changing color toward a dark red/burgundy! strain the tea leaves. ⁣ ⁣ 🌸separately warm up milk, mix the tea with milk. add sugar to your liking and top with pistachios or almonds! ⁣ ⁣ this pot took me about an hour to make, the color only comes with a lot of patience, aerating and whisking over and over, and of course don’t forget the baking soda 😅💞⁣ ⁣ have you ever made kashmiri chai? is there any easier way to achieve this gorgeous dusty pink color? let me know below! ☺️☕️
recipes.caption:
Let’s make Kashmiri chai together, a milk tea made from green tea leaves that naturally turns  pink when made with the secret ingredient I call, patience 🤲🏼💗☕️🫖⁣
⁣
Recipe ⁣
Cinnamon stick (1)⁣
Star anise (1-2)⁣
Cardamom pods (handful)⁣
Loose green tea leaves (half cup)⁣
Milk (2 cups) ⁣
Sugar (per your liking)⁣
Salt (dash) ⁣
Baking soda (1.5 teaspoons) ⁣
⁣
🌸Place cinnamon stick, star anise, cardamom and green tea leaves in 3 cups of water. ⁣
⁣
🌸Bring to boil approximately 2-3 times. Aerate/whisk the liquid so much that it evaporates and reduces to one cup, then add ice 🧊 cold water to replace the evaporated water. ⁣
⁣
🌸Add baking soda, and a pinch of salt. Allow that to boil for approximately 15-25 mins on medium heat, if water reduces, keep adding more cold water to replenish. ⁣
⁣
🌸After a while, the liquid should start changing color toward a dark red/burgundy! Strain the tea leaves. ⁣
⁣
🌸Separately warm up milk, mix the tea with milk. Add sugar to your liking and top with pistachios or almonds! ⁣
⁣
This pot took me about an hour to make, the color only comes with a lot of patience, aerating and whisking over and over, and of course don’t forget the baking soda 😅💞⁣
⁣
Have you ever made Kashmiri chai? Is there any easier way to achieve this gorgeous dusty pink color? Let me know below! ☺️☕️
recipes.recipe_ingredients:
Cinnamon stick (1)
Star anise (1-2)
Cardamom pods (handful)
Loose green tea leaves (half cup)
Milk (2 cups)
Sugar (per your liking)
Salt (dash)
Baking soda (1.5 teaspoons)
recipes.recipe_method:
Place cinnamon stick, star anise, cardamom and green tea leaves in 3 cups of water.
Bring to boil approximately 2-3 times. Aerate/whisk the liquid so much that it evaporates and reduces to one cup, then add ice 🧊 cold water to replace the evaporated water.
Add baking soda, and a pinch of salt. Allow that to boil for approximately 15-25 mins on medium heat, if water reduces, keep adding more cold water to replenish.
After a while, the liquid should start changing color toward a dark red/burgundy! Strain the tea leaves.
Separately warm up milk, mix the tea with milk. Add sugar to your liking and top with pistachios or almonds!

recipes.title: Gyoza Ramen
recipes.author: sarahdoig
recipes.text: speedy gyoza ramen 🍜 is there anything better than a big, cosy bowl of ramen when it’s grey and rainy outside? 😍 this one is super quick to make, it’s all in one pot and it’s ready in about 10 minutes - perfect for those nights when you can’t be bothered cooking! recipe serves 2 for the broth: 1 tbsp tahini 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil 1 tbsp miso 1 tbsp tamari/soy sauce 1 large garlic clove/1 tsp minced garlic 1 tsp minced ginger 500ml vegetable stock 250ml soya milk 2 portions of pre-cooked noodles or instant ramen noodles 2 portions frozen gyoza toppings of choice (i had edamame, pak choi, sesame seeds and chilli oil) add the tahini, miso, sesame oil, tamari/soy sauce, garlic and ginger to a pot. add a splash of broth and whisk together to make a smooth, creamy paste. add the broth and soy milk and whisk well. bring to a simmer and leave to bubble for a few minutes to cook out the ginger and garlic. add the ramen noodles and gyoza and cover with a lid. leave to simmer for a further couple of minutes until cooked through. serve in bowls, add your toppings and enjoy! 💛
recipes.caption:
SPEEDY GYOZA RAMEN 🍜
Is there anything better than a big, cosy bowl of ramen when it’s grey and rainy outside? 😍 this one is super quick to make, it’s all in one pot and it’s ready in about 10 minutes - perfect for those nights when you can’t be bothered cooking! 

Recipe serves 2
For the broth:
1 tbsp tahini 
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil 
1 tbsp miso 
1 tbsp tamari/soy sauce
1 large garlic clove/1 tsp minced garlic 
1 tsp minced ginger 
500ml vegetable stock 
250ml soya milk 

2 portions of pre-cooked noodles or instant ramen noodles 
2 portions frozen gyoza 
Toppings of choice (I had edamame, pak Choi, sesame seeds and chilli oil) 

 
Add the tahini, miso, sesame oil, tamari/soy sauce, garlic and ginger to a pot. Add a splash of broth and whisk together to make a smooth, creamy paste. 

Add the broth and soy milk and whisk well. Bring to a simmer and leave to bubble for a few minutes to cook out the ginger and garlic. 

Add the ramen noodles and gyoza and cover with a lid. Leave to simmer for a further couple of minutes until cooked through. 

Serve in bowls, add your toppings and enjoy! 💛

recipes.recipe_method:

Add the broth and soy milk and whisk well. Bring to a simmer and leave to bubble for a few minutes to cook out the ginger and garlic.
Add the ramen noodles and gyoza and cover with a lid. Leave to simmer for a further couple of minutes until cooked through.
Serve in bowls, add your toppings and enjoy! 💛

recipes.title: Spicy Bhindi Chutney
recipes.author: ohcheatday
recipes.text: spicy bhindi chutney !! you must be thinking is it even possible ?? haha i bet you have never heard of this karnataka special dish ?? it taste too good with chawala and dal recipe (serves 4) ingredients lady's finger: 250 g red chilies 6-8 (remove few seeds or else would get too spicy) fenugreek seeds: 1/2 tsp cumin seeds: 1 +1/2 teaspoon coriander seeds: 2 tablespoons mustard seeds: 1 teaspoon garlic: 7 to 8 cloves small lemin size tamarind salt: to taste method of preparations: take 1/4 kg of lady's finger/okra and cut them into small pieces, heat a pan and roast red chilies in oil. roast until change in color, transfer them to a separate bowl. to the same pan add 1/2 a tsp of fenugreek seeds, 1 tsp of cumin seeds, 2 tbsp of coriander seeds roast them, cook bhindi now till it’s well cooked now add oil in the same pan cook garlic, 1/4 tsp mustard seeds, curry leaves 1 sprig, add a large tomato to the same pan along with 2 reeds of washed tamarind, salt n pepper and fry until soft with a lid on it. add salt & pepper the dry red chilli, okra and tomato paste to chutney. optional can add an extra tempering of oil & red chilli

the dry red chilli, okra and tomato paste to chutney. 

Optional can add an extra tempering of oil & red chilli

recipes.title: Thai Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.author: cookwithchay
recipes.text: thai style chicken stir fry chicken marinade 1. 600 grams chicken thighs (about 5 chicken thighs) 2. 2 tablespoons course ground coriander 3. 1 tablespoon course ground black pepper 4. 5 garlic minced 5. 2 teaspoons ginger minced 6. 2 tablespoons oyster sauce 7. 1/2 teaspoon salt sauce : 1. 5 small red onion or 2 large sliced 2. 2-3 tablespoons chili flakes- or however much you like 1-2 teaspoons?? 3. 3 tablespoons brown sugar 4. 2 tablespoons corn starch or rice powder (browned and grinded ) 5. 3 tablespoons tamarind water 6. 2 tablespoons lime juice 7. 2 tablespoons fish sauce 8. 2 tablespoons cilantro chopped ( more for garnish) to saute: 2 tablespoons butter 1 tablespoon oil 1. cut chicken thighs into long strips . 2. add all chicken ingredients to chicken and marinate for 30 minutes or more 3. mix all sauce ingredients and set aside. 4. in a skillet add butter and oil and sauté garlic for 30 seconds (do not burn) 5. add in chicken and cook for 8-10 minutes on medium high heat stir after the first minute to get a nice sear. 6. add the onion mixture and cook another 2-3 minutes mixing well to incorporate all the flavors. 7. garnish with more cilantro. 8. serves 3-4 people. 9. serve as a main dish , over rice or noodles with a cold beer ! chickens lunch bbq salad beef mongolian chinese food take out fake away eeeeeats thai huffposttaste bhg
recipes.caption:
Thai Style Chicken Stir Fry 

Chicken marinade 
1. 600 grams chicken thighs (about 5 chicken thighs) 
2. 2 tablespoons course ground coriander 
3. 1 tablespoon course ground black pepper
4. 5 garlic minced 
5. 2 teaspoons ginger minced 
6. 2 tablespoons oyster sauce 
7. 1/2 teaspoon salt 

Sauce : 
1. 5 small red onion or 2 large sliced 
2. 2-3 tablespoons chili flakes- or however much you like 1-2 teaspoons??
3. 3 tablespoons brown sugar 
4. 2 tablespoons corn starch or rice powder (browned and grinded ) 
5. 3 tablespoons tamarind water 
6. 2 tablespoons lime juice 
7. 2 tablespoons fish sauce 
8. 2 tablespoons cilantro chopped ( more for garnish) 

To Saute: 
2 tablespoons butter 
1 tablespoon oil 

1. Cut chicken thighs into long strips . 
2. Add all chicken ingredients to chicken and marinate for 30 minutes or more
3. Mix all sauce ingredients and set aside. 
4. In a skillet add butter and oil and sauté garlic for 30 seconds (do not burn)
5. Add in chicken and cook for 8-10 minutes on medium high heat stir after the first minute to get a nice sear. 
6. Add the onion mixture and cook another 2-3 minutes mixing well to incorporate all the flavors. 
7. Garnish with more cilantro. 
8. Serves 3-4 people.

1. 600 grams chicken thighs (about 5 chicken thighs)

recipes.title: Pazham Pori (Plantain Fritters)
recipes.author: renes.cravings
recipes.text: with a cup of tea: pazham pori aka plantain fritters 🍌 this tea time snack is what i get at tea stands in kerala🌴 the hot, slightly crispy fried plantain is naturally a bit sweet and goes so so so well with a hot cup of chai 🫖 ingredients: 1 cup plain flour 2tbs rice flour 1/2 tsp cumin seeds 2tbs sugar 1/4 tsp turmeric and a pinch of salt water as needed 2-3 ripe plantains all you have to do is mix the flour, rice powder, salt, sugar, turmeric and cumin seeds with some water till you get a smooth, cake batter kinda consistency. slice your plantains, dip it into the batter and fry in some hot oil till lightly golden and a bit crispy! my mums favourite are the ones my ammechi (grandma) makes butttt, i don’t think anything can beat a pazham pori from a chaya kada 🤪🛺
recipes.caption:
With a Cup of Tea: Pazham Pori aka plantain fritters 🍌

This tea time snack is what I get at tea stands in Kerala🌴 The hot, slightly crispy fried plantain is naturally a bit sweet and goes so so so well with a hot cup of chai 🫖 

Ingredients: 
1 cup plain flour 
2tbs rice flour 
1/2 tsp cumin seeds 
2tbs sugar 
1/4 tsp turmeric and a pinch of salt
Water as needed 
2-3 ripe plantains 

All you have to do is mix the flour, rice powder, salt, sugar, turmeric and cumin seeds with some water till you get a smooth, cake batter kinda consistency. 
Slice your plantains, dip it into the batter and fry in some hot oil till lightly golden and a bit crispy! 

My mums favourite are the ones my ammechi (grandma) makes BUTTTT, I don’t think anything can beat a pazham pori from a chaya kada 🤪🛺

recipes.title: Scissor-Cut Noodles
recipes.author: brendan_pang
recipes.text: scissor-cut noodles ✂️ all you need is 2 parts plain flour, 1 part water and a pair of scissors. noodle dough - 400g plain flour - 1/2 tsp salt - 200ml water fried garlic butter (optional) - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 3 tbsp butter - 1 tsp chilli flakes - 2 tsp minced garlic - 1 red chilli, sliced - 1 tsp white sesame seeds - 3 tbsp light soy sauce - 2 tbsp chopped chives mix flour and salt together in a bowl then pour in water while stirring with chopsticks. use your hands to combine then turn onto a bench and knead until smooth, about 10 minutes. cover with cling wrap and rest for 30 minutes. bring a pot of water to the boil then hold the dough over and carefully cut strips of noodles into the pot. cook for 2 minutes then strain and use as desired. to make the fried garlic butter, place oil and butter in a small saucepan over medium to high heat. add chilli flakes, garlic, fresh chilli and sesame seeds. stir cooking until the garlic is fragrant then add in soy sauce. add the cooked noodles and chopped chives and toss. serve immediately.

recipes.title: Hand-Cut Egg Noodles
recipes.author: brendan_pang
recipes.text: hand-cut egg noodles 🔪 no fancy tools or equipment needed, just your hands and a handful of ingredients. you can add these noodles to soup, stir-fry them or serve with a simple sauce. noodle dough - 500g plain flour - 1/2 tsp salt - 6 eggs - cornstarch, for dusting hot oil sauce (optional) - 2 tsp minced garlic - 2 tsp minced spring onion - 1 tsp chilli flakes - 1 tsp white sesame seeds - 2 tbsp neutral oil - 1 1/2 tbsp light soy sauce - 1 tbsp black vinegar - 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce mix flour and salt together on a clean work surface. make a well in the centre then add in the eggs. using chopsticks gently break up the eggs, then using your hands working the dough until a shaggy ball. don’t worry if it gets messy, it will all come together. knead for 8 - 10 minutes until smooth then wrap in cling wrap and rest for 30 minutes. cut into 4 portions and working with 1 portion, roll to your desired thickness. make sure to use cornstarch to dust. fold the dough onto itself then cut to your desired thickness. to cook the noodles, bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook for 60-90 seconds. drain, and use as desired. to make the hot oil sauce, place into a mound the minced garlic and spring onion, chilli flakes and white sesame seeds. heat oil until hot then pour over to sizzle. add light soy sauce, black vinegar and dark soy sauce. toss until well combined and enjoy.
recipes.caption:
HAND-CUT EGG NOODLES 🔪 No fancy tools or equipment needed, just your hands and a handful of ingredients. You can add these noodles to soup, stir-fry them or serve with a simple sauce.

Noodle Dough
- 500g plain flour
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 6 eggs
- Cornstarch, for dusting

Hot Oil Sauce (optional)
- 2 tsp minced garlic
- 2 tsp minced spring onion
- 1 tsp chilli flakes
- 1 tsp white sesame seeds
- 2 tbsp neutral oil
- 1 1/2 tbsp light soy sauce
- 1 tbsp black vinegar
- 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce

Mix flour and salt together on a clean work surface. Make a well in the centre then add in the eggs. Using chopsticks gently break up the eggs, then using your hands working the dough until a shaggy ball. Don’t worry if it gets messy, it will all come together. Knead for 8 - 10 minutes until smooth then wrap in cling wrap and rest for 30 minutes. Cut into 4 portions and working with 1 portion, roll to your desired thickness. Make sure to use cornstarch to dust. Fold the dough onto itself then cut to your desired thickness. To cook the noodles, bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook for 60-90 seconds. Drain, and use as desired.

To make the hot oil sauce, place into a mound the minced garlic and spring onion, chilli flakes and white sesame seeds. Heat oil until hot then pour over to sizzle. Add light soy sauce, black vinegar and dark soy sauce. Toss until well combined and enjoy.

Mix until creamy.
Serve with the eggplant.

INGREDIENTS
2 10 oz. cans Old El Paso Enchilada Sauce
1 cup quinoa, uncooked
1 small onion, diced
1 small red bell pepper, diced
1 jalapeno, diced small
1/2 tsp cumin seeds

-Add quinoa, enchilada sauce and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover lid and let cook for about 15 minutes. Check in between and stir if necessary (add splash of water if needed).

-Once the quinoa has cooked, add in the scallions, cheese, sour cream and serve immediately while hot!

recipes.caption:
10 Million views 🎉 thank you so much❤️
Achari Chicken Handi- Quick easy boneless Achari Chicken

This is my quick and tastiest Achari Chicken Handi recipe and it takes roughly 30 minutes to prepare and always a crowd pleaser. 

For the Achari Masala:
2-3 tbsp oil
1 tbsp Zeera (Cumin Seeds)
1 tsp Fenugreek/Methi Seeds
1 tsp Mustard Seeds
1 tsp Nigella/Kalonji Seeds
1 tsp Fennel Seeds/Saunf Seeds

For the Gravy:
2 chopped onions
1-inch ginger
3-4 cloves of garlic
2-3 green chillies
3-4 tomatoes
1 cup yogurt

For the Chicken:
2-3 tbsp oil
500g Boneless chicken thigh cubes (or chicken breast) thigh pieces are better
1 tsp salt
1 tsp Red chilli powder
1 tsp Degi mirch
1 tsp Coriander powder
1 tsp Zeera powder

For Garnish:
Handful of chopped coriander
For Stuffed Chillies:

Large green chillies
1 tbsp vinegar (for soaking)
3-4 tbsp chat masala
2-3 tbsp lemon juice
Batter (made with chat masala and lemon juice)

Instructions:
Step 1:
In a hot pan, add oil and the Achari Masala ingredients (Zeera, Fenugreek, Mustard Seeds, Nigella Seeds, Fennel Seeds). Stir for a couple of minutes on medium low heat. Make sure not to burn the spices we need the achari fragrance at the stage. 

Step 2:
Add chopped onions, ginger, garlic, and green chillies. Fry until the onions are translucent.

Step 3:
Add tomatoes and yogurt. Mix for approximately five minutes. Grind this mixture and set aside.

Step 4:
In the same pan, add more oil and the boneless chicken cubes. Stir until the chicken changes color.

Add salt, red chilli powder, Degi mirch, coriander powder, and Zeera powder. Mix for 2-3 minutes.

Add the ground mixture from step 3. Cook for a few minutes and leave it on steam for 10-15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.

Once the chicken is cooked, add chopped coriander.

For the stuffed chillies, clean and slit large green chillies. Soak them in vinegar for 30 minutes.

Mix chat masala with lemon juice to make a thick batter. Stuff the chillies with this mixture and place them on top of the chicken.

Cook on low heat for 5-6 minutes until the chillies are cooked in steam and become soft.

Serve the Achari Chicken Handi with fresh chapatis.
