The pot is from TK Max London

recipes.title: Spicy Tofu Broccoli Rice
recipes.author: browngirlvegan_
recipes.text: 20 days of 20-minute quick meals ep 16: spicy rice with tofu & charred broccoli🍜 on some days, you just want to put something easy together with a simple marinade and still want it to taste amazing ❤️ this spicy fusion rice includes a mix of chili oil and indian spices as well as a one-marinade tofu and broccoli baked until roasted. full recipe below 👇 ingredients (for 2) tofu & broccoli 1 tbsp chili oil 1 tbsp light soy sauce broccolini or a head of broccoli 200g extra firm tofu spicy rice 1.5 - 2 cups cooked rice 2 tsp chili oil 1 tsp ginger paste 1 tsp garam masala 1/4 tsp turmeric pinch of hing (or 1 tsp minced garlic) 1 tbsp dark soy sauce directions: preheat over to 200c. cut broccoli into florets or if using broccolini, cut off the stems. slice tofu into rectangles. mix soy sauce and chili oil together. brush the marinade over the tofu and broccoli until evenly coated. bake for 15 minutes and grill for 3 minutes, flipping halfway. meanwhile, add chili oil to a pan. add ginger paste, garam masala, turmeric, hing and saute until fragrant. add cooked rice, 1 tbsp dark soy sauce and mix well. fry on the pan until fragrant and well coated (i used a claypot) serve rice with tofu, broccoli and garnish with scallions and sesame seeds. enjoy!
recipes.caption:
20 DAYS OF 20-MINUTE QUICK MEALS EP 16: Spicy Rice with Tofu & Charred Broccoli🍜 

On some days, you just want to put something easy together with a simple marinade and still want it to taste amazing ❤️ This Spicy fusion rice includes a mix of chili oil and indian spices as well as a one-marinade tofu and broccoli baked until roasted. Full recipe #dEATs below 👇

Ingredients (for 2)

Tofu & Broccoli
1 tbsp chili oil 
1 tbsp light soy sauce 
Broccolini or a head of broccoli 
200g extra firm tofu 

Spicy Rice 
1.5 - 2 cups cooked rice
2 tsp chili oil
1 tsp ginger paste
1 tsp garam masala
1/4 tsp turmeric 
pinch of hing (or 1 tsp minced garlic)
1 tbsp dark soy sauce 

Directions: 

Preheat over to 200C. 
Cut broccoli into florets or if using broccolini, cut off the stems. Slice tofu into rectangles. 
Mix soy sauce and chili oil together. 
Brush the marinade over the tofu and broccoli until evenly coated. 
Bake for 15 minutes and grill for 3 minutes, flipping halfway. 

Meanwhile, add chili oil to a pan. 
Add ginger paste, garam masala, turmeric, hing and saute until fragrant. 
Add cooked rice, 1 tbsp dark soy sauce and mix well. 
Fry on the pan until fragrant and well coated (I used a claypot)

Serve rice with tofu, broccoli and garnish with scallions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

recipes.caption:
Smashed Fried Chicken - Indonesian Ayam Penyet

Spice paste:
4 medium sized shallot
6 garlic cloves
6 candlenuts
3 inch piece fresh ginger
3 inch piece fresh turmeric
1/4 water

Chicken:
6 whole chicken legs
2 tablespoons oil
1 tsp salt
2 tsp chicken bouillon 
1 tsp ground coriander 
1 tsp white pepper 
1/2 tsp MSG, optional
2 lemongrass stalks, bruised
2 lime leaves, torn
2 bay leaves
2 cups water

Directions:
1. To make the spice paste: place all the ingredients into a food processor and blend until smooth.
2. Into a skillet add 2 Tbsp. of the oil and cook the spice paste until the liquid has mostly evaporated and the mixture is dry. Add the remaining ingredients and let it come to a boil. Taste the broth. It should be slightly salty, adjust as needed. Add the chicken and once it has come to a boil, lower the heat and put the lid on slightly ajar, cook for 30-40 minutes until most of the liquid has been evaporated.
3. Remove the chicken and place inside the air fryer basket skin side up, may need to do this in 2 batches. Spray the chicken and air fry for 15 minutes at 400F.
4. To deep fry the chicken, add enough oil to cover the bottom of a skillet and fry the chicken skin side down for about 4 minutes or until golden brown. Flip and cook for a few more minutes. Serve with rice and keemes (fried flakes)

Sambal:
About 15 Thai chili peppers
4 shallots
4 garlic cloves 
1 tomato, quartered 

- use a mortar and pestle of use a food processor to make blend the ingredients. I like mine a little chunky.
- Into a skillet add 2 tablespoons oil and fry the paste for about 5-7 minutes. Add a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lime juice. Add a pinch of sugar, optional. Serve with chicken and enjoy!

recipes.title: Orange Chutney
recipes.author: keertidacooks
recipes.text: ever tried an orange chutney? i didn’t even know of one, till i came across a bewitchingly simple recipe in tiffin, a tantalising book of memories and recipes by rukmini srinivas. this orange chutney recipe harnesses the sweet-tangy, fresh flavour of this citrus fruit and elevates it by pairing it with ginger that provides a floral heat and fragrant curry leaves. it pairs beautifully with besan/ moong chilla, i’ve tossed a spoonful into fried rice that got the most unique flavour lift, is most excellent with buttered baguette and while the author pairs it with cutlets, i can also imagine it going so well with cheese and crackers. made a few tweaks to the original recipe, here is my version: 3 oranges- peeled. separate the slices- remove the inner white membrane, thin threads, seeds. the slices will naturally separate into 3-4 pieces in this process, collect everything in a bowl. save the peel of 1/4-1/2 an orange and slice it into thin strips- the peel has fragrant oils, but is also bitter- start with less the first time you make it, add more as needed next time. combine the peeled segment pieces and sliced peel in the bowl. now in a kadhai, temper 1 tbsp oil with 1/8 tsp mustard seeds a fat pinch of heeng 7-8 curry leaves, torn 1-2 green chilies, sliced 1/8 tsp turmeric powder 2 tsp ginger, finely chopped quickly tip in the orange and stir everything together now add salt, to taste. also add 1.5 tsp sugar/ more- this will depend on how sweet your oranges are. start with 1.5
recipes.caption:
Ever tried an orange chutney?   I didn’t even know of one, till I came across a bewitchingly simple recipe in Tiffin, a tantalising book of memories and recipes by Rukmini Srinivas.

This orange chutney recipe harnesses the sweet-tangy, FRESH flavour of this citrus fruit and elevates it by pairing it with ginger that provides a floral heat and fragrant curry leaves. 

It pairs beautifully with besan/ moong chilla,  I’ve tossed a spoonful into fried rice that got the most unique flavour lift, is most excellent with buttered baguette and while the author pairs it with cutlets, I can also imagine it going so well with cheese and crackers. 

Made a few tweaks to the original recipe, here is my version:

3 oranges- peeled. Separate the slices- remove the inner white membrane, thin threads, seeds. The slices will naturally separate into 3-4 pieces in this process, collect everything in a bowl.
Save the peel of 1/4-1/2 an orange and slice it into thin strips- the peel has fragrant oils, but is also bitter- start with less the first time you make it, add more as needed next time.
Combine the peeled segment pieces and sliced peel in the bowl.

Now in a Kadhai, temper 
1 Tbsp oil with 
1/8 tsp mustard seeds
A fat pinch of heeng
7-8 curry leaves, torn 
1-2 green chilies, sliced
1/8 tsp turmeric powder
2 tsp ginger, finely chopped

Quickly tip in the orange and stir everything together 

Now add salt, to taste.

Also add 
1.5 tsp sugar/ more- this will depend on how sweet your oranges are. Start with 1.5 tsp, taste and add more as needed.

Let everything reduce and turn jammy- about 4-5 mins.
Taste- see if you need salt, sugar.

Turn off the heat, add a generous squeeze of lime, mix well and transfer to a serving bowl.

Make this while Nagpur santra is abundantly available now, put it on your breakfast table, and let’s hope a desi Enid Blyton of our times tastes it, falls in love with it and puts it in books that will be read across the globe and generations, so that an orange chutney feels as obvious as a marmalade.

recipes.title: Homemade Chilli Oil
recipes.author: withanushkarawat
recipes.text: restocked my chilli oil and this one is by far the best version!😌✨ ingredients: 1/2+1/4th cup any neutral oil 1 inch cinnamon stick 4-5 peppercorns 3-4 cloves 1 star anise 1 bay leaf 1 finely chopped onion 1 inch ginger sliced 10-12 finely chopped garlic cloves 4-5 tbsp chilli flakes (or more as per your spice tolerance) 1 tsp dark soy sauce 1 tsp salt a pinch of sugar recipe - ✨heat the oil in a pan & add the whole spices along with onions. cook till the onions turn crispy brown, will take around 7-10 min. keep it on low heat only! ✨once done, strain the oil and in the same pan heat the oil again and add garlic & chilli flakes. let the garlic turn crisp, then turn off the heat. add salt, a pinch of sugar & soy sauce. mix & let it cool down completely. ✨store in an airtight jar and enjoyyyy!🤤 chilli oil, spicy chilli oil recipe
recipes.caption:
Restocked my Chilli oil and this one is by far the best version!😌✨

INGREDIENTS: 

1/2+1/4th cup any neutral oil
1 inch cinnamon stick
4-5 peppercorns 
3-4 cloves
1 star anise
1 bay leaf
1 finely chopped onion
1 inch ginger sliced
10-12 finely chopped garlic cloves
4-5 tbsp chilli flakes (or more as per your spice tolerance) 
1 tsp dark soy sauce
1 tsp salt 
A pinch of sugar

RECIPE - 

✨Heat the oil in a pan & add the whole spices along with onions. Cook till the onions turn crispy brown, will take around 7-10 min. Keep it on low heat only! 

✨Once done, strain the oil and in the same pan heat the oil again and add garlic & chilli flakes. Let the garlic turn crisp, then turn off the heat. Add salt, a pinch of sugar & soy sauce. Mix & let it cool down completely. 

✨Store in an airtight jar and enjoyyyy!🤤

recipes.title: Moong Dal Paratha
recipes.author: diningwithdhoot
recipes.text: rajasthani moong dal paratha 🇮🇳 this paratha is definitely going to be your new favourite! it is so delicious & i love the addition of moong dal. recipe: - start by soaking 1 cup moong dal for 4-5 hours in water. then drain completely - in a bowl add 2 cups atta, the soaked moong dal. - 1 tsp nigella seeds (kalonji), 1 tsp fennel seeds (saunf), 2 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder, 1 tsp hing, 1 tsp salt, pinch of haldi & mix this well - now add 1/3 cup chopped coriander & wtee gradually (1/3 cup approx) & knead this well into a soft dough - cover with a wet towel & set aside for at least 30 mins - now brush 1-2 tbsp oil on it & knead for 5 mins. - divide into smaller balls, roll into parathas with some atta to dust - heat a tawa, & place your paratha. let it cook as is without anything for 2 mins meanwhile brush the ghee / oil / butter on the other side - then flip & cook well on both sides - serve hot with dahi / acchar / raita & enjoy!!

7 INGREDIENT VEGAN - CREAMY GYOZA SOUP 🍜

By @Nomeatdisco

Recipe:

Ingredients
•1 tbsp red Thai curry paste
•1 packet of Noodles
• 150ml of your choice of plant based Cream
• 1 punnet of Mushrooms
•1 bunch of Pak Choy
• 5 Gyoza (I used @itsuofficial )
•3 cloves Garlic

Extras - 1 stock cube, salt pepper, chilli oil if you like spice, sesame seeds for an optional crunch.

Method:
1. Fry off the garlic, Pak choy and mushrooms in some oil for 5 mins.
2. Add in the red Thai curry paste, stir to combine. Then go in with 300ml stock and the cream. Bring to a boil, season to your taste then lower the heat to a simmer and cover with a lid.
3. Whilst that’s blipping away add some oil to a pan, fry the gyoza for 3-4 mins over a medium heat until the bottoms are crispy. Pour in a small amount of stock and cover with a lid, cook for 5 mins or until most of the liquid has dissolved.
4. Add your noodles to the soup and cook to packet instructions.
5. Serve up your soup with the noodles, top with the gyoza and sesame seeds and chilli oil which is optional and enjoy!

recipes.title: Bubur Ayam
recipes.author: winnyhayes
recipes.text: bubur ayam (indonesian rice porridge with chicken) 3 lbs chicken pieces, preferably dark meat about 8 cups water 2 inch piece garlic 6 garlic cloves 2 green onion stalks 1 cup short grain rice like arborio or sushi 1 teaspoon salt or to taste 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon or to taste 1/2 teaspoon white pepper or to taste 4 tablespoons butter toppings: chicken youtiao (chinese fried dough) boiled egg green onion fried shallots soy sauce kecap manis sesame oil sambal kerupuk (shrimp crackers) directions: 1. into a large pot add the chicken, water, ginger, garlic and green onion. make sure the chicken is submerged. let it come to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for 45 minutes. 2. remove the chicken pieces, ginger, garlic and green onion from the pot. rinse rive thoroughly and add into the pot. let it come to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for 90 minutes. stirring occasionally to prevent sticking to the bottom of the pot. 3. once porridge has reached desired texture add the salt, chicken bouillon, white pepper and butter. stir to combine. 4. to serve, place porridge into a bowl and add your toppings. mix well and enjoy!

3. Once porridge has reached desired texture add the salt, chicken bouillon, white pepper and butter. Stir to combine.
4. To serve, place porridge into a bowl and add your toppings. Mix well and enjoy!

recipes.caption:
COCONUT & CORIANDER NOODLE SOUP 🌶️

Welcome to Episode 2 of Speedy Vegan💥 if you can’t be bothered cooking but still want something flavoursome and nutritious, this noodle soup is where it’s at 😍 it’s ready in about 15 minutes, SO easy to make and it’s perfect for warming up on a freezing cold day 🥶 

You can add in whatever veg you fancy, I love tenderstem broccoli, sugar snap peas and pak choi but peppers, frozen edamame or spinach and kale would also be great. Whatever you have in the fridge! 

Recipe serves 2
For the broth: 
30g coriander 
3 garlic cloves 
1-inch piece of ginger 
1 green chilli 
1 1/2 tbsp miso 
1 x 400 ml tin of coconut milk 
250 ml water 

2 portions of cooked noodles 
Veg of choice (Tenderstem broccoli, sugar snap peas, shredded pak choi all work well)

Toppings: 
Sesame seeds
Sliced spring onions 
Chilli oil 
Lime wedges 
Soy sauce/tamari 

Crispy tofu:
200g firm tofu, crumbled 
1 tbsp soy sauce or tamari 
Mix soy sauce and tofu. Pop into oven proof dish or silicone liner and air fry at 180°C or spread over a tray and oven bake at 200°C for 15-20 minutes or until golden and crispy. 

Add all of the ingredients for the broth to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour the broth into a large pot with a lid. Bring to a gentle simmer and then add the noodles and veg. Pop the lid on and leave to cook for a few minutes. 

Once the veg is tender, finish with a squeeze of lime and soy sauce/tamari, to taste. 

Serve up, drizzle with chilli oil and a sprinkle of sliced spring onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy! 💛

#veganrecipes #easymeals #easyveganfood #noodlesoup #easydinner

For the broth:
30g coriander
3 garlic cloves
1-inch piece of ginger
1 green chilli
1 1/2 tbsp miso
1 x 400 ml tin of coconut milk
250 ml water
2 portions of cooked noodles
Veg of choice (Tenderstem broccoli, sugar snap peas, shredded pak choi all work well)
Toppings:
Sesame seeds
Sliced spring onions
Chilli oil
Lime wedges
Soy sauce/tamari
Crispy tofu:
200g firm tofu, crumbled
1 tbsp soy sauce or tamari
recipes.recipe_method:
Mix soy sauce and tofu. Pop into oven proof dish or silicone liner and air fry at 180°C or spread over a tray and oven bake at 200°C for 15-20 minutes or until golden and crispy.
Add all of the ingredients for the broth to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour the broth into a large pot with a lid. Bring to a gentle simmer and then add the noodles and veg. Pop the lid on and leave to cook for a few minutes.
Once the veg is tender, finish with a squeeze of lime and soy sauce/tamari, to taste.
Serve up, drizzle with chilli oil and a sprinkle of sliced spring onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy! 💛

recipes.caption:
This is the best Ragi Chocolate Walnut Cake recipe, hands down! 🍫🎂 The star ingredient is @californiawalnutsindia that are PURE GOLD and I had the chance to witnessing California Walnuts being harvested sometime ago and they are grown under strict quality control at all times. I love how it helps getting the blends of beautiful creamy textures in this recipe! 

Here’s how you can make this wholesome cake at home ☺️

Ingredients: 
Ragi flour - 3/4th Cup/ 107g
Whole Wheat Flour - 3/4th Cup/ 100g
Jaggery powder - 3/4th Cup/ 164g 
Cocoa powder - 6 Tbsps/ 32g
Baking Soda - 1 Tsp
Baking Powder - 2.5 Tsps
Salt - 1/4th Tsp
Oil - 6 Tbsps/ 77g
Curd - 1/3rd Cup/ 102g 
Vanilla - 1/2 Tsp
Coffee Pwd - 1 Tsp
Vinegar - 1/2 Tbsp/ 14g 
Hot Water - 3/4th Cup/ 176g
California Walnuts- 1 cup
Choco chips - 1/4th cup

Process : 
* Pre-heat the oven to 170C 
* In a bowl, add in the powdered jaggery, coffee powder with hot water - whisk & allow the jaggery to melt completely 
* Next, add in the oil & curd - whisk the wet ingredients 
* ⁠Combine the ragi flour & whole wheat flour along with some cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda & salt - combine the dry ingredients using a whisk 
* Add the dry ingredients into the wet mix in 2-3 parts & combine to form a smooth & lump-free batter 
* ⁠Finish with vinegar and fold it in 
* ⁠Before folding the walnuts- toss them in 1 tablespoon of the dry mix 
* Transfer the batter to a lined loaf tin 
* Top up the cake with whole walnuts & chocolate chips. Cover with foil and Bake the cake in a pre-heated 170C oven for 25-30 mins/ until a skewer inserted comes out clean 
* Allow the cake to cool down slightly & de-mould it carefully - cool it down fully
* Serve, Slice & Enjoy 🍫♥️

recipes.caption:
CREAMY VANILLA CASHEW MILK (NO-STRAIN)✨ the staple of all recipe staples in my daily routine! This creamy, flavorful, homemade cashew milk is not only a more delicious and cost effective option than store-bought milks, its also a healthier choice because its naturally sweetened and doesn’t contain any of the artificial flavors, thickeners, or seed oils that at all too common in the milks lining store shelves. Once you taste this, you will never go back to store-bought and your at-home latte ritual will become even more cherished! 

Ingredients:
1.5 cups soaked raw cashews (soaked at least 4 hours or up to overnight)
7 cups water 
1/4 cup coconut cream 
1 heaping tbsp vanilla extract 
3 tbsp honey (or maple syrup or 3 pitted dates)
1 tsp sea salt

Directions:
Add your raw cashews to an airtight container and cover with water
Soak overnight or for at least 4 hours
Strain your cashews and rinse until the water runs clear
Add all of your ingredients to a high speed blender (like a @vitamix) and blend for 2 minutes until frothy
Store in the fridge in an airtight container for up to a week
Enjoy!

FAQs: 
▫️How long does it last in the fridge? 
5-7 days
▫️Can I use roasted cashews? 
Yes, but raw cashews have a more subtle flavor and creamier finish 
▫️How long do I soak the cashews?
I soak mine overnight. I suggest a minimum of 4 hours.
▫️What is coconut cream?
Coconut cream is the thick layer at the top of a can of coconut milk
▫️What if I don’t have a high powered blender? 
Strain the mixture through a nut milk bag after blending
▫️Is separation normal?
Yes! Simply shake it up before use. (Grittiness is NOT normal. This means you didn’t blend for long enough or your blender isn’t high powered enough.)
▫️ Can I omit the coconut cream?
Yes, the coconut cream is for extra creaminess but it can be omitted
▫️Can I use almonds? 
Yes, but you will need to strain the blended mixture through a nut milk bag
▫️How much milk does the recipe make? 
About 2 liters 
▫️Where do I find your milk bottles?
Linked in my Amazon store in my bio
▫️Does it froth?
A little! Not as much as thinner milks due to the high fat content

recipes.title: Honey Butter Toast
recipes.author: thechefmine
recipes.text: honey butter toast 🍯🧈 recipe below 👇🏽 ingredients honey butter toast: 4 thick slices of brioche bread 6 tbs/80g softened unsalted butter ¼ cup light brown sugar 2 tbs honey pinch of salt vanilla cream (optional): ½ cup cold heavy cream 1 tbs vanilla bean paste (try to get this over vanilla extract. it’ll make a huge difference) 1 tbs powdered sugar steps: 1. preheat your oven to 180°c/356°f. 2. trim the crusts of your brioche slices and set them aside. 3. in a small bowl combine the butter and brown sugar with a spatula. 4. add salt and honey and mix. 5. spread the butter mixture evenly over all the faces of the slices of bread- the top, bottom and sides. 6. place on a baking tray and bake for 10 minutes, then remove from the oven and gently flip each piece of bread. 7. return to the oven for 8 more minutes. 8. take the toast out and let them sit for about 2 minutes without touching them before moving them to a cooling rack. they will be very hot and soft, but they’ll harden as they cool. 9. let them sit on the cooling rack for about 8-10 minutes, then enjoy. 10. if making the whipped cream, mix the cold heavy cream, vanilla bean paste and powdered sugar in a bowl. you can add more sugar if you want, but i don’t recommend making it very sweet as it may overpower the toast. 11. whip until stiff peaks form then top your toast with it. *for the salted caramel recipe, scroll down my page to january 2023*
recipes.caption:
Honey butter toast 🍯🧈 Recipe below 👇🏽

Ingredients
Honey butter toast: 
4 thick slices of brioche bread 
6 tbs/80g softened unsalted butter 
¼ cup light brown sugar 
2 tbs honey
Pinch of salt

Vanilla cream (optional):
½ cup cold heavy cream
1 tbs vanilla bean paste (try to get this over vanilla extract. It’ll make a huge difference)
1 tbs powdered sugar 

Steps: 
1.  Preheat your oven to 180°C/356°F. 
2. Trim the crusts of your brioche slices and set them aside. 
3. In a small bowl combine the butter and brown sugar with a spatula. 
4. Add salt and honey and mix. 
5. Spread the butter mixture evenly over all the faces of the slices of bread- the top, bottom and sides. 
6. Place on a baking tray and bake for 10 minutes, then remove from the oven and gently flip each piece of bread. 
7. Return to the oven for 8 more minutes. 
8. Take the toast out and let them sit for about 2 minutes without touching them before moving them to a cooling rack. They will be very hot and soft, but they’ll harden as they cool. 
9. Let them sit on the cooling rack for about 8-10 minutes, then enjoy. 
10. If making the whipped cream, mix the cold heavy cream, vanilla bean paste and powdered sugar in a bowl. You can add more sugar if you want, but I don’t recommend making it very sweet as it may overpower the toast. 
11. Whip until stiff peaks form then top your toast with it. 

*For the salted caramel recipe, scroll down my page to January 2023*

7. Return to the oven for 8 more minutes.
8. Take the toast out and let them sit for about 2 minutes without touching them before moving them to a cooling rack. They will be very hot and soft, but they’ll harden as they cool.

recipes.caption:
Have you tried whipping cottage cheese before??
.
I know there’s a lot of trust issues with cottage cheese, but i promise, this whipped cottage cheese is on a whole new level. Its creamy, rich, and the texture is on point!
.
Since this is super rich, you wont need as much.. a couple tablespoons goes a long way. So divide this up accordingly. You can easily get 4-6 servings out of this, maybe even more, and be completely satisfied.
.
Here is how I made it:
.
1. Grab 1 small tub (16oz or 4 servings) of cottage cheese and put it into a small food processor with 2/3 cup cacao powder and 1/2 cup to 3/4 cup of monkfruit or your favorite sweetener. ***IMPORTANT: use POWDERED sweetener or it will be gritty****.Pulse for about 15-20 seconds to get it creamy and remove the clumps.  You can always taste and see what more you’d like to add.
.
2.This is best chilled - so i highly recommend chilling for 1-2 hours unless youre anxious to get going right away! 
.
3.You can serve this as is, but if you want to upgrade it, you can add some crushed roasted hazelnuts, or a tablespoon or two of melted chocolate! Layer it up however way you want.
.
4.If you do add melted chocolate on top, you can just mix 2 tablespoons of stevia-sweetened chocolate chips with 1 tsp or so of coconut oil, microwave for 15 seconds, stir, microwave again for 15 seconds. Pour it over the top, then let it chill so you can break the top chocolate layer with a spoon.
.
If you make it… let me know what you think!! I also have a few different version of this using blueberries on my page @SHREDHAPPENS if you want to go a few videos back.
.
ENJOY.

You can always taste and see what more you’d like to add.
2.This is best chilled - so i highly recommend chilling for 1-2 hours unless youre anxious to get going right away!
3.You can serve this as is, but if you want to upgrade it, you can add some crushed roasted hazelnuts, or a tablespoon or two of melted chocolate! Layer it up however way you want.
4.If you do add melted chocolate on top, you can just mix 2 tablespoons of stevia-sweetened chocolate chips with 1 tsp or so of coconut oil, microwave for 15 seconds, stir, microwave again for 15 seconds. Pour it over the top, then let it chill so you can break the top chocolate layer with a spoon.

recipes.caption:
Thai Basil Chicken - Pad Kra Pao 

Thai Basil Stir Fry
* ½ cup red onion or shallot (diced or shallots roughly chopped)
* 16 oz ground chicken 
* 5 garlic cloves minced 
* ½ cup Thai basil or regular basil 
* 1 medium red chili (chopped roughly)
* 1 jalapeno pepper or 1/2 green bell diced 
* Neutral oil 2-3 tablespoons (chicken shoukd not be dry ) 

Sauce
* 2 tablespoon light soy sauce
* 2 tablespoon dark soy sauce 
* 1 tablespoon honey or maple syrup 
* 2 tablespoons garlic chili sauce or sriracha 
* 2 tablespoon oyster sauce
* 2 tablespoon fish sauce

For serving
* 1 cup uncooked rice for serving
* 2-3 stalks of green onion for garnish
* More basil leaves
* Sesame seeds
* 2 fried eggs

1. Mix all sauce ingredients and set aside. 
2. In a wok or skillet add 2-3 tablespoons oil and sauté shallot or onion , garlic and jalapeno. Cook 1 minute without burning. 
3. Add in ground chicken and cook just until no longer pink. Do NOT overcook and dry out chicken.  Add oil if it looks dry.  Should be a bit juicy/saucey from chicken and oil. 
4. Stir the sauce and add the sauce to the chicken. 
5. Cook until everything is incorporated. Turn off the heat. 
6. Add the fresh basil and stir then add red chile and a squeeze of lime. 
7. Serve over rice. 
8. Garnish with more fresh basil, lime and sesame seeds and sliced green onion and a fried egg .

recipes.title: Sweet and Spicy Udon Noodles
recipes.author: thechutneylife
recipes.text: never met a bowl of noodles i didn’t like 🤩. save this because these sweet and spicy udon noodles are chewy, saucy and you can add a ton of veggies to them like cabbage, peppers, or eggplant. if you want protein, tofu, edamame, shrimp or chicken would be great too! ingredients * 14.2 oz package of udon noodles * 2 tbsp minced garlic * 2 medium shallots, thinly sliced * 1 tsp grated ginger * 8 oz shiitake mushrooms sliced * 1 baby bok choy, chopped * 2 tbsp oil to make the sauce, combine the following ingredients in a bowl and set aside: * 2 tbsp dark soy sauce * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce * 1 tbsp sweet thai chili sauce * 1 tbsp gochujang * 1 tsp gochugaru or crushed red chili flakes * 1 tsp rice wine vinegar * 1/2 tsp sesame oil instructions * cook or prepare the noodles according to package directions. i had udon noodles that did not require boiling but i did rinse them with hot water to simply help loosen them up. follow the directions for whichever type of noodles you decide to use. * heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large wok or pot over medium high heat. once the oil is hot, add the shallots and stir until they become soft. * next, add the mushrooms and cook until the mushrooms are for just about tender but not too soft. reduce the heat to medium/low, add the garlic, ginger, bok choy, and stir until garlic is fragrant and bok choy starts to slightly wilt. * add the noodles, sauce, sesame seeds and stir until well combined and noodles are heated through. * serve hot and fresh!! udon noo
recipes.caption:
Never met a bowl of noodles I didn’t like 🤩. Save this because these sweet and spicy udon noodles are chewy, saucy and you can add a ton of veggies to them like cabbage, peppers, or eggplant. If you want protein, tofu, edamame, shrimp or chicken would be great too! 

INGREDIENTS
* 14.2 oz package of udon noodles
* 2 tbsp minced garlic
* 2 medium shallots, thinly sliced
* 1 tsp grated ginger
* 8 oz shiitake mushrooms sliced
* 1 baby bok choy, chopped
* 2 tbsp oil

To make the sauce, combine the following ingredients in a bowl and set aside:
* 2 tbsp dark soy sauce
* 1 tbsp hoisin sauce
* 1 tbsp sweet thai chili sauce
* 1 tbsp gochujang
* 1 tsp gochugaru or crushed red chili flakes
* 1 tsp rice wine vinegar
* 1/2 tsp sesame oil

INSTRUCTIONS
* Cook or prepare the noodles according to package directions. I had udon noodles that did not require boiling but I did rinse them with hot water to simply help loosen them up. Follow the directions for whichever type of noodles you decide to use. 
* Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large wok or pot over medium high heat. Once the oil is hot, add the shallots and stir until they become soft. 
* Next, add the mushrooms and cook until the mushrooms are for just about tender but not too soft. Reduce the heat to medium/low, add the garlic, ginger, bok choy, and stir until garlic is fragrant and bok choy starts to slightly wilt. 
* Add the noodles, sauce, sesame seeds and stir until well combined and noodles are heated through. 
* Serve hot and fresh!!

Serve hot and fresh!!

recipes.text: ten minute gochujang noodle soup! if you loved my viral gochujang noodles, you need to try this soupy version. it’s fiery yet creamy and sooo slurpable, especially during these nippier months. start by cooking your noodles of choice. i’m using ramen. you can blanche some leafy greens like bok choy as well whilst the noodles are cooking. drain the noodles , but reserve the hot and starchy noodle water. to a heatproof bowl, add: - 2-3 cloves of minced garlic - knob of ginger, grated - 1-2 tsp sesame seeds - 2-3 tsp gochugaru/ chilli flakes add 1.5 tbsp of hot sesame oil, followed by: - 1/2 tbsp gochujang paste - 1 tbsp peanut butter/ tahini - 1 tbsp soy sauce - 1/2 tbsp rice vinegar give it a brisk whisk to combine well. then ladle in the noodle water until you have a soupy consistency. drop in your cooked noodles along with all your favourite toppings. here we have bok choy, kimchi , scallions and of course, my homemade chilli oil. give it a good mix and dive in! {gochujang noodles, ramen recipe, noodle soup, comfort food recipes, easy dinner ideas, vegan recipes, }
recipes.caption:

To a heatproof bowl, add:
- 2-3 cloves of minced garlic

recipes.text: stuffed chillies 🌶️ ✨ get ready for a flavor explosion with these stuffed chilies! they’re packed with a mix of spices, roasted perfection, and a whole lot of yum. it’s the kind of spicy goodness that makes your taste buds do a happy dance. dive into this deliciousness today! ingredients: 8 chilli pepper 1/4 cup peanuts 1/5 cup toor dal 1 tsp cumin seed 1 tsp coriander seed 7-8 kapok buds( marati moggu in kannada) 1 tsp fennel seed 1 tsp sesame seed 1/4 tsp turmeric 6-7 small garlic 1/2 tsp hing 1 tsp homemade garam masala( recipe already posted) 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp sugar 2 tbsp oil thread (to tie the chillies) method: clean the chilies, then slit and remove the seeds. in a pan, roast the ingredients, grind them to make powder, and stuff the masala into the chilies. tie them with clean thread. in a large pan, add oil and roast. sprinkle some water, cover the lid, and cook. then, add the leftover masala on top, sauté for 1-2 minutes. while serving, cut the thread and serve.✨

recipes.text: make your own ginger shots at home! 2 cups fresh organic ginger root (washed + any weird bits cut off, no need to fully peel) juice of 3-4 organic lemons 2-3 cups filtered water 1-2 tablespoons of turmeric powder (or you can use the full turmeric root if you have access to it!) 1-2 tablespoon of raw honey pinch of black pepper blend the ginger, lemons, and water in a high speed blender. pour into a straining bag and strain. pour the strained ginger lemon juice back in the blender and add turmeric powder, pepper, honey. blend until combined. store in the fridge i like more watered down (aka i enjoy drinking it), instead of burn your throat ginger. but you do you! also, add a splash to hot water for the most soothing tea. enjoy!

recipes.caption:
Here is your sign to start eating amaranth seeds if you don’t already! Amaranth seeds are a great underrated superfood loaded with magnesium, selenium, iron and protein. I’ve found the best way to incorporate amaranth is in this 7 ingredient granola which is also oil free and sweetened with dates. Save this recipe and follow @chefaashti for more healthy-ish vegan recipes! 

Oil Free Amaranth Granola

* 3 cups puffed amaranth (store bought or home made, tips below)
* 1 cup nuts of choice- I’ve used cashews – roughly chopped
* 1 cup seeds of choice- I’ve used pumpkin and sunflower seeds
* 1/4 cup nut butter - I’ve used almond
* 1/4 cup date syrup or liquid jaggery, make sure it’s runny and not too thick 
* pinch salt
* 1/2 tsp vanilla extract options
* 1/3 cup raisins 

1. To pop amaranth seeds- use a high heavy bottomed pan preferably with a lid. I haven’t used one, just to show you how they pop but otherwise the amaranth seeds will fly all over.
2. Heat the pan on medium to high, add a sprinkle of water to the pan to check if it’s hot enough. If the water forms a ball, you know the pan is hot enough. 
3. Add in 1/2 tbsp of amaranth seeds at a time. They should start to pop immediately- if you have to wait too long then theban isn’t hot enough. Cover with a lid and shake the pan so the seeds don’t get stuck. This takes some practice but don’t get discouraged if you you burn the seeds a few times. 
4. You can also buy puffed amaranth if you don’t want to go through the trouble :)
5. Preheat oven to 140 degrees Celsius.
6. Add all granola ingredients to a large bowl and mix until the granola is evenly coated. It’s easier to mix your hands. 
7. Add granola to a flat layer to a sheet pan lined with parchment paper.
8. Bake for 8 mins. Take out and mix well. Bake again for about 6-8 mins until done. Amaranth seeds cook much faster than an oat granola so make sure it doesn’t burn.
9. Once done add in the raisins and let it cool for 15 mins. (I forgot to add raisins in mine 😅) Store in a sealed container for a few weeks. Don’t refrigerate.

3. Add in 1/2 tbsp of amaranth seeds at a time. They should start to pop immediately- if you have to wait too long then theban isn’t hot enough. Cover with a lid and shake the pan so the seeds don’t get stuck. This takes some practice but don’t get discouraged if you you burn the seeds a few times.

recipes.title: Spinach Avocado Parathas
recipes.author: twinsbymyside
recipes.text: today’s lunch for my toddlers: spinach avocado parathas. they are easy to make, delicious and packed with nutrition for children. do try these 💚 ingredients: 1 avocado 1 tbsp lime juice 1/2 tsp turmeric 1 tsp coriander powder 1 tsp ginger garlic paste 1/2 tsp crushed carom seeds salt to taste fistful chopped spinach 2 tbsp chopped cilantro leaves 1 cup whole wheat flour 2 tbsp yoghurt 1 tsp oil sesame seeds method: start by slicing an avocado in half, remove the pit and scoop into a bowl. then use a fork and gently mash the avocado. add lime juice and the spices: turmeric, coriander powder, crushed carom seeds. add ginger garlic paste. salt and finely chopped spinach and cilantro. add whole wheat flour and mix together, add yoghurt and knead into dough, towards the end drizzle oil and knead to form soft dough. cover and it let it rest for 10-15 mins. make toddler sized portion balls from the dough. roll into paratha, sprinkle sesame seeds and gently roll so sesame seeds stick to the dough. heat a tawa/skillet on medium heat and place the paratha on it. using ghee/ oil cook both sides. serve with dahi. . .
recipes.caption:
Today’s lunch for my toddlers: Spinach avocado parathas. They are easy to make, delicious and packed with nutrition for children. 
Do try these 💚

Ingredients: 1 avocado
1 tbsp lime juice
1/2 tsp turmeric 
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp ginger garlic paste 
1/2 tsp crushed carom seeds
salt to taste 
Fistful chopped spinach 
2 tbsp chopped cilantro leaves 
1 cup whole wheat flour 
2 tbsp yoghurt 
1 tsp oil
Sesame seeds 

Method: Start by slicing an avocado in half, remove the pit and scoop into a bowl. Then use a fork and gently mash the avocado. Add lime juice and the spices: turmeric, coriander powder, crushed carom seeds. Add ginger garlic paste. salt and finely chopped spinach and cilantro. 
Add whole wheat flour and mix together, add yoghurt and knead into dough, towards the end drizzle oil and knead to form soft dough.
Cover and it let it rest for 10-15 mins. 
Make toddler sized portion balls from the dough. 
Roll into paratha, sprinkle sesame seeds and gently roll so sesame seeds stick to the dough.
Heat a tawa/skillet on medium heat and place the paratha on it. Using ghee/ oil cook both sides. 
Serve with dahi.

recipes.recipe_method:
Start by slicing an avocado in half, remove the pit and scoop into a bowl. Then use a fork and gently mash the avocado. Add lime juice and the spices: turmeric, coriander powder, crushed carom seeds. Add ginger garlic paste. salt and finely chopped spinach and cilantro.
Add whole wheat flour and mix together, add yoghurt and knead into dough, towards the end drizzle oil and knead to form soft dough.
Cover and it let it rest for 10-15 mins.
Make toddler sized portion balls from the dough.
Roll into paratha, sprinkle sesame seeds and gently roll so sesame seeds stick to the dough.
Heat a tawa/skillet on medium heat and place the paratha on it. Using ghee/ oil cook both sides.
Serve with dahi.

recipes.title: Salt Pepper Chicken Halloumi Rice
recipes.author: dinner_at_hols
recipes.text: 15 days of one pot wonders . day 11 . salt and pepper chicken and halloumi rice . ⬇️ recipe below ⬇️ . press save for dinner inspiration 📌 follow for more recipes like this. . recipe serves 4 . ingredients . 500g chicken, diced 150g halloumi, diced - i used light halloumi 2tbs cornflour 1tbs of salt and pepper seasoning 1 onion, sliced 2 peppers, sliced 4 cloves garlic, finely diced 1 red chilli, sliced (optional) 500g cooked rice- i used microwave rice 1tbs light soy i garnished mine with sweet chilli sauce, chilli mayo, chilli flakes and sesame seeds (optional) . method. . start by mixing together the cornflour and seasoning and then coat the chicken and halloumi. fry this off until crispy and cooked through then remove from the pan. add in the onions and peppers and cook until they’re starting so soften then add in the garlic and the chilli. cook that for a minute or so and then add in the cooked rice and soy sauce. give it a good mix and add the chicken and halloumi back in. garnish, serve and enjoy! . calories- 543 protein- 53.6g . if you don’t have any salt and pepper seasoning you can swap it for chinese 5 spice. .
recipes.caption:
15 Days of One Pot Wonders 
.
Day 11
.
Salt and Pepper Chicken and Halloumi Rice 
.
⬇️ Recipe below ⬇️ 
.
Press save for dinner inspiration 📌 follow @dinner_at_hols for more recipes like this. 
.
Recipe serves 4 
.
Ingredients 
.
500g chicken, diced 
150g Halloumi, diced - I used light halloumi 
2tbs cornflour 
1tbs of salt and pepper seasoning 
1 onion, sliced 
2 peppers, sliced 
4 cloves garlic, finely diced 
1 red chilli, sliced (optional) 
500g cooked rice- I used microwave rice 
1tbs light soy 
I garnished mine with sweet chilli sauce, chilli mayo, chilli flakes and sesame seeds (optional) 
.
Method. 
.
Start by mixing together the cornflour and seasoning and then coat the chicken and halloumi. Fry this off until crispy and cooked through then remove from the pan. Add in the onions and peppers and cook until they’re starting so soften then add in the garlic and the chilli. Cook that for a minute or so and then add in the cooked rice and soy sauce. Give it a good mix and add the chicken and halloumi back in. Garnish, serve and enjoy! 
.
Calories- 543 
Protein- 53.6g 
.
If you don’t have any salt and pepper seasoning you can swap it for Chinese 5 spice.
.

recipes.title: 2-Minute Chocolate Mug Cake
recipes.author: clairehodginss
recipes.text: 2-minute chocolate mug cake 🍫😋 this is the perfect breakfast or snack to make when you want something sweet! it’s sooo delicious and easy to make 🙌 i used my favorite madagascar vanilla whey protein powder in this recipe! it’s my favorite because its made with natural ingredients and adds the perfect sweet vanilla taste 🍦 you can use my code ✨claire✨ for 15% off promix! ingredients: - 1/2 cup oats - 2/3 cup water - 1 serving vanilla whey protein powder - 2 tbsp cocoa powder - 1/2 tbsp maple syrup (or sweetener of choice) - pinch of salt - 1 tbsp peanut or almond butter how to: - add the oats, water, protein powder, cocoa powder, maple syrup and pinch of salt to a blender. - blend for 30 seconds or until smooth. - pour into a small oven safe bowl and microwave for 1-1.5 minutes. the edges should be cooked but the center should still be a little soft. - drizzle peanut butter on top and enjoy! makes 1 serving: 433 cals, 35g protein, 48g carb, 14g fat
recipes.caption:
2-MINUTE CHOCOLATE MUG CAKE 🍫😋

This is the perfect breakfast or snack to make when you want something sweet! It’s sooo delicious and easy to make 🙌

I used my favorite @promix Madagascar Vanilla whey protein powder in this recipe! It’s my favorite because its made with natural ingredients and adds the perfect sweet vanilla taste 🍦

You can use my code ✨CLAIRE✨ for 15% off Promix! 

Ingredients: 
- 1/2 cup oats
- 2/3 cup water
- 1 serving @promix vanilla whey protein powder
- 2 tbsp cocoa powder
- 1/2 tbsp maple syrup (or sweetener of choice)
- pinch of salt 
- 1 tbsp peanut or almond butter

How to: 
- Add the oats, water, protein powder, cocoa powder, maple syrup and pinch of salt to a blender.

recipes.title: Chatpate Sukhe Aloo and Bathua Poori
recipes.author: thespicystory
recipes.text: chatpate sukhe aloo & bathua poori 😍 - my mother in law makes the best sukhe aloo and if you try it once, you will never go back to your regular sukhi aloo sabzi again. it’s delicious and highly addictive. i bet you will eat extra poori with this. these gorgeous utensils are from ingredients - for aloo ki sabzi - 7-8 potatoes, boiled, peeled and chopped 4-5 tbsp oil 1-1/2 tsp cumin seeds 2 tbsp coriander powder 1 tbsp red chilli powder 1/2 tbsp kashmiri red chilli powder 1/2 tbsp garam masala powder 1-1/2 tbsp amchur powder 2-3 tbsp ginger, finely chopped 3-4 green chillies, finely chopped salt, to taste for bathua ki poori - 2 cups whole wheat flour 2 tbsp sooji salt, to taste 1 tbsp ghee 1-1/2 cup bathua puree 1/2 tsp ajwain instructions - boil, peel and chop the potatoes. keep aside. heat oil in a pan. add cumin seeds and let it splutter. add coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder and amchur powder. mix well and add the potatoes, ginger and green chillies. mix everything well and cook for about a minute. add in salt and mix again. cook until the potatoes are lightly crispy. serve with bathua ki poori.
recipes.caption:
CHATPATE SUKHE ALOO & BATHUA POORI 😍 - My mother in law makes the best sukhe aloo and if you try it once, you will never go back to your regular sukhi aloo sabzi again. It’s delicious and highly addictive. I bet you will eat extra poori with this. 

These gorgeous utensils are from @ptal.in 

Ingredients - 
For Aloo Ki Sabzi - 
7-8 potatoes, boiled, peeled and chopped
4-5 tbsp oil
1-1/2 tsp cumin seeds
2 tbsp coriander powder
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1/2 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli powder
1/2 tbsp garam masala powder
1-1/2 tbsp amchur powder
2-3 tbsp ginger, finely chopped
3-4 green chillies, finely chopped
Salt, to taste

For Bathua Ki Poori - 
2 cups whole wheat flour
2 tbsp sooji
Salt, to taste
1 tbsp ghee
1-1/2 cup bathua puree
1/2 tsp ajwain

Instructions - 
Boil, peel and chop the potatoes. Keep aside. 
Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let it splutter. Add coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder and amchur powder. Mix well and add the potatoes, ginger and green chillies. Mix everything well and cook for about a minute. 
Add in salt and mix again. Cook until the potatoes are lightly crispy. Serve with Bathua Ki Poori.

recipes.author: yumvegantreats
recipes.text: pull apart garlic bread via written recipe below i adapted a recipe from for this one, i turned her ‘vegan japanese milk bread’ into this tasty garlic bread here ingredients -4 tbsp bread flour (30g) -1/2 cup soy milk (120ml) -4 tbsp water (60ml) -720g bread flour (6 cups) -1/2 cup brown sugar (100g) -4 tsp dried active yeast -1 tsp salt -1 + 1/2 cups warm soy milk (360ml) -2/3 cup vegan butter (140g) -125g vegan butter -2 roasted garlic heads -bunch of parsley method -mix the flour, water and milk starter then heat on medium for 2-3 minutes until the mixture thickens to a wet paste. set aside and allow to cool. -now mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt then gradually add the soy milk, vegan butter and flour paste and combine. -once combined knead into for 15 minutes, then cover and rest for 1.5hrs -mix the roasted garlic, butter and parsley then set aside. -roll the dough out to a few cm/1 inch thick then spread over the garlic butter, vegan cheese, herbs and salt. -cut the dough into equal sized squares then layer them on top of each other and transfer to a greased loaf tin. -bake in the oven for 30 minutes then cover with foil and bake for another 15-30 minutes. -serve with a delicious ragu/pasta sauce, best enjoyed whilst still warm from the oven
recipes.caption:
Pull Apart Garlic Bread via @jacobking

written recipe below

I adapted a recipe from @jessicainthekitchen for this one, I turned her ‘vegan Japanese milk bread’ into this tasty garlic bread here

INGREDIENTS
-4 tbsp bread flour (30g)
-1/2 cup soy milk (120ml)
-4 tbsp water (60ml)

-720g bread flour (6 cups)
-1/2 cup brown sugar (100g)
-4 tsp dried active yeast
-1 tsp salt
-1 + 1/2 cups warm soy milk (360ml)
-2/3 cup vegan butter (140g)

-125g vegan butter
-2 roasted garlic heads
-bunch of parsley

METHOD
-mix the flour, water and milk starter then heat on medium for 2-3 minutes until the mixture thickens to a wet paste. Set aside and allow to cool.
-now mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt then gradually add the soy milk, vegan butter and flour paste and combine.
-once combined knead into for 15 minutes, then cover and rest for 1.5hrs
-mix the roasted garlic, butter and parsley then set aside.
-roll the dough out to a few CM/1 inch thick then spread over the garlic butter, vegan cheese, herbs and salt.
-cut the dough into equal sized squares then layer them on top of each other and transfer to a greased loaf tin.
-bake in the oven for 30 minutes then cover with foil and bake for another 15-30 minutes.
-serve with a delicious ragu/pasta sauce, best enjoyed whilst still warm from the oven

recipes.title: Sweet Chilli Cajun Chicken Tacos
recipes.author: veryhungrygreek
recipes.text: sweet chilli cajun chicken tacos 🥵 these beauties were crispy, sticky and had so much flavour!! and ready in under 15 mins 🙌 macros 563 calories 51gp / 8gf / 69gc serves: 2 shopping list ✍️ - 2 chicken breasts - salt & pepper - 25g cajun seasoning - 1 egg or egg white - 50g cornflakes - 3 tbsps sweet chilli sauce - 1 tsp honey - lettuce, sliced - cherry tomatoes, diced - 4 mini tortilla wraps optional: a drizzle of garlic & herb dressing 🤤 method mix together the sweet chilli sauce and honey and set aside. cut the chicken breasts into tenders (3-4 each breast) then season with 1 tbsp cajun seasoning, salt and pepper. crush the cornflakes then season with the remaining 2 tsp cajun seasoning. dip the chicken tenders into whisked egg then the cornflakes, place in the air fryer, spray with low calorie spray and cook on 180c for 6 mins. flip then spray again and cook for a further 6 mins or until cooked, for the last 2 mins brush over the sticky glaze. assemble the tacos with the salad and add an optional drizzle of garlic and herb sauce and enjoy!
recipes.caption:
Sweet chilli Cajun chicken tacos 🥵 

These beauties were crispy, sticky and had SO much flavour!! And ready in under 15 mins 🙌

Dip the chicken tenders into whisked egg then the cornflakes, place in the air fryer, spray with low calorie spray and cook on 180C for 6 mins. Flip then spray again and cook for a further 6 mins or until cooked, for the last 2 mins brush over the sticky glaze. Assemble the tacos with the salad and add an optional drizzle of garlic and herb sauce and enjoy!

recipes.caption:
Healthy shrimp and chive rice paper dumplings✨

▪️1 lb. Peeled and Deveined Shrimp, cut into small pieces then rough chopped▪️1 Clove Garlic, minced▪️3/4 Cup Chinese Chives (also known as garlic chives), chopped small▪️1 Tbsp Fresh Ginger, minced▪️1 Tbsp Cornstarch▪️1/4 tsp Kosher Salt▪️1/4 tsp Pepper▪️1 Tbsp Sesame Oil▪️1 Tbsp Soy Sauce▪️12-14 Sheets Rice Paper▪️2 Tbsp Avocado Oil▪️

For the Sauce (or sub sweet chili sauce):▪️1 Clove Garlic, minced▪️1 Tbsp Carrot, minced▪️2 Limes, juice▪️2 Tbsp Fish Sauce▪️

🌱Vegan Modification: Sub in 1 lb. mixed mushrooms (or small diced tofu) for shrimp (sauté the veggie filling before folding the dumplings); sub in soy sauce for fish sauce in the sauce

1️⃣ Preheat oven to 400F convection (if you have it, no worries if not); mix together the ingredients for the sauce and set aside
2️⃣ Add the shrimp, garlic, Chinese chives, ginger, cornstarch, salt, pepper, sesame oil, and soy sauce to a bowl and mix
3️⃣ Fill up a large bowl (or pie dish) with water and place two damp paper towels on a cutting board; soak the rice paper wrapper in water for ~15 seconds (don't leave it in too long bc it will continue to soften as you work) and place on the paper towel
4️⃣ Cut the rice paper in half down the middle, break it in two pieces, and put 1 Tbsp of the shrimp mixture in the middle of each piece
5️⃣ Fold the sides of the rice paper over to filling (it will create a triangle shape) then flip the dumpling over and fold the excess rice paper onto the other side
6️⃣ Drizzle a baking sheet with 2 Tbsp avocado oil and add the dumplings; roll each dumpling in oil on both sides as you place them on the baking sheet
7️⃣ Convection bake for 13-15 mins until shrimp is pink and bottoms of the dumplings are golden brown (if you don’t have convection you may need to cook 3-5 mins longer), then broil 2-3 mins until tops of the dumplings are golden brown (watch closely while you broil because the dumplings can burn easily)
8️⃣ Serve with sauce and enjoy!

⏲20 minute prep time + 15 minute cook time

Recipe makes ~24 dumplings
recipes.recipe_ingredients:
1 lb. Peeled and Deveined Shrimp, cut into small pieces then rough chopped
1 Clove Garlic, minced
3/4 Cup Chinese Chives (also known as garlic chives), chopped small
1 Tbsp Fresh Ginger, minced
1 Tbsp Cornstarch
1/4 tsp Kosher Salt
1/4 tsp Pepper
1 Tbsp Sesame Oil
1 Tbsp Soy Sauce
12-14 Sheets Rice Paper
2 Tbsp Avocado Oil
For the Sauce (or sub sweet chili sauce):
1 Clove Garlic, minced
1 Tbsp Carrot, minced
2 Limes, juice
2 Tbsp Fish Sauce
Vegan Modification: Sub in 1 lb. mixed mushrooms (or small diced tofu) for shrimp (sauté the veggie filling before folding the dumplings); sub in soy sauce for fish sauce in the sauce
recipes.recipe_method:
Preheat oven to 400F convection (if you have it, no worries if not); mix together the ingredients for the sauce and set aside
Add the shrimp, garlic, Chinese chives, ginger, cornstarch, salt, pepper, sesame oil, and soy sauce to a bowl and mix
Fill up a large bowl (or pie dish) with water and place two damp paper towels on a cutting board; soak the rice paper wrapper in water for ~15 seconds (don't leave it in too long bc it will continue to soften as you work) and place on the paper towel
Cut the rice paper in half down the middle, break it in two pieces, and put 1 Tbsp of the shrimp mixture in the middle of each piece
Fold the sides of the rice paper over to filling (it will create a triangle shape) then flip the dumpling over and fold the excess rice paper onto the other side
Drizzle a baking sheet with 2 Tbsp avocado oil and add the dumplings; roll each dumpling in oil on both sides as you place them on the baking sheet
Convection bake for 13-15 mins until shrimp is pink and bottoms of the dumplings are golden brown (if you don’t have convection you may need to cook 3-5 mins longer), then broil 2-3 mins until tops of the dumplings are golden brown (watch closely while you broil because the dumplings can burn easily)
Serve with sauce and enjoy!

recipes.text: the best banana bread you will have in your life!! i promise! merry chrysler / merry chrimson / merry christmas 🎄 ——- recipe: - 4-5 ripe bananas - 1 cup salted butter (softened) - 1 cup white sugar - 1 cup brown sugar - 5 eggs - 1 cup almond flour - 1 cup ap flour - 1 tsp sesame oil - 2 tsp baking soda - 3 tsp vanilla extract - 1 tbsp cinnamon - handful of chocolate chips (optional) 1. mash up 4-5 banana then add in your white sugar, brown sugar, butter and eggs and mix. 2. add in the almond flour, ap flour, baking soda, vanilla extract, cinnamon and chocolate chips and mix again. 3. grease a bread pan with oil spray or butter and pour in your mix. depending on the size of your pan, you may need to do it twice or use 2 pans. 4. bake at 350 f for 1 hour. (test by poking it with a knife and if it comes out clean, it is ready) 5. let it rest for 10 minutes before cutting. enjoy! save this and follow for more!
recipes.caption:
The BEST Banana bread you will have in your life!! I promise!
Merry Chrysler / Merry Chrimson / Merry Christmas 🎄 ——- 
Recipe:

- 4-5 ripe bananas 
- 1 cup salted butter (softened)
- 1 cup white sugar
- 1 cup brown sugar
- 5 eggs
- 1 cup Almond flour 
- 1 cup AP flour
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 2 tsp baking soda
- 3 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 tbsp cinnamon 
- handful of chocolate chips (optional)

1. Mash up 4-5 banana then add in your white sugar, brown sugar, butter and eggs and mix.
2. Add in the almond flour, AP flour, baking soda, vanilla extract, cinnamon and chocolate chips and mix again.
3. Grease a bread pan with oil spray or butter and pour in your mix. Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to do it twice or use 2 pans.
4. Bake at 350 F for 1 hour. (test by poking it with a knife and if it comes out clean, it is ready)
5. Let it rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.author: mrsyumtum
recipes.text: broccoli fires (serves 1-2) well this recipes is from my brains. i keep experimenting for my kid as she is a fussy eater. came up with this. do try it out. potato broccoli mix -2 boiled potatoes -half of a broccoli blanched & cooled. -chop the broccoli super fine in a chopper. -2tbsp full cornflour -1tsp pizza seasoning -1/2tsp pepper powder -salt to taste -mix everything well to make dough like consistency. tip: if you feel your mix it too sticky & not holding shape add some more cornflour. making fries: -take a regular piping bag. put the mix into it. now press & push the mixture down till the tip. -cut the tip off to the thickness you need. -now lay a parchment paper. pipe out to make fries like shape(don’t worry it not difficult you will get a hang after you make 2-3) tip: you can directly pipe out in the oil but the shape may get distorted but the taste still remains same😊 -now grease your hand a little, pick the fries & drop in hot oil. -deep fry in high flame till crispy. tip: you can air fry these as well. tip : if you think making fries out of this is an hassle just make tikkis out of it & fry. they taste equally delicious. enjoy with any dip of your choice!! yumtum !!
recipes.caption:
Broccoli Fires
(Serves 1-2)

Well this recipes is from my brains. I keep experimenting for my kid as she is a fussy eater. Came up with this. Do try it out.

Potato Broccoli mix
-2 boiled potatoes 
-half of a broccoli blanched & cooled. 
-chop the broccoli super fine in a chopper. 
-2tbsp full cornflour 
-1tsp pizza seasoning 
-1/2tsp pepper powder 
-Salt to taste 
-Mix everything well to make dough like consistency.
Tip: if you feel your mix it too sticky & not holding shape add some more cornflour. 

Making fries:
-Take a regular piping bag. Put the mix into it. Now press & push the mixture down till the tip. 
-Cut the tip off to the thickness you need. 
-Now lay a parchment paper. Pipe out to make fries like shape(don’t worry it not difficult you will get a hang after you make 2-3)
Tip: you can directly pipe out in the oil but the shape may get distorted but the taste still remains same😊
-Now grease your hand a little, pick the fries & drop in hot oil. 
-Deep fry in high flame till crispy. 
Tip: you can air fry these as well. 
Tip : if you think making fries out of this is an hassle just make tikkis out of it & fry. They taste equally delicious. 

Enjoy with any dip of your choice!! 

YumTum !!

chop the broccoli super fine in a chopper.
Mix everything well to make dough like consistency.
Tip: if you feel your mix it too sticky & not holding shape add some more cornflour.
Take a regular piping bag. Put the mix into it. Now press & push the mixture down till the tip.
Cut the tip off to the thickness you need.
Now lay a parchment paper. Pipe out to make fries like shape(don’t worry it not difficult you will get a hang after you make 2-3)
Tip: you can directly pipe out in the oil but the shape may get distorted but the taste still remains same😊

Deep fry in high flame till crispy.
Tip: you can air fry these as well.

Enjoy with any dip of your choice!!

recipes.text: recipe ⬇️ welcome to episode 27 of healthy dinner recipe series 🍃 i am a clinical dietitian and i know most of us struggle to eat a healthy and balanced dinner, so i am here to sort your dinners with nourishing and delicious recipes. do not forget to follow to not miss the upcoming recipes ✅ method of “palak mung dal + millet roti ”🍀 for this one serving shown in the video, i have used 1/2 cup mung dal & 150 g spinach 😇 1. soak 1/2 cup mung for atleast 2 hours 2. heat some oil in a pan & add jeera, mustard seeds & little hing (asafoetida) 3. once it crackles, add garlic paste & let it cook for 30 secs 4. time to add soaked mung & chopped spinach 5. close the lid & let it cook for 5 minutes without stirring until the spinach reduces. you need not add water at this stage. spinach will leave moisture & the dal will get cooked in that water. 6. now add the spices - salt, turmeric, chili powder & coriander seeds powder. 7. stir everything well, add little water & cover. 8. let it cook for another 10 minutes or until the dal is cooked. 9. enjoy it hot with any millet roti. i used bajra roti 😊 save this reel & follow for more such balanced recipes ✅
recipes.caption:
Recipe ⬇️

Welcome to episode 27 of Healthy Dinner Recipe Series 🍃 I am a Clinical Dietitian and I know most of us struggle to eat a healthy and balanced dinner, so I am here to sort your Dinners with nourishing and delicious recipes. Do not forget to follow to not miss the upcoming recipes ✅

Method of “Palak mung dal + millet roti ”🍀

For this one serving shown in the video, I have used 1/2 cup mung dal & 150 g spinach 😇

1. Soak 1/2 cup mung for atleast 2 hours
2. Heat some oil in a pan & add jeera, mustard seeds & little hing (asafoetida)
3. Once it crackles, add garlic paste & let it cook for 30 secs
4. Time to add soaked mung & chopped spinach
5. Close the lid & let it cook for 5 minutes without stirring until the spinach reduces. You need not add water at this stage. Spinach will leave moisture & the dal will get cooked in that water.
6. Now add the spices - salt, turmeric, chili powder & coriander seeds powder.
7. Stir everything well, add little water & cover.
8. Let it cook for another 10 minutes or until the dal is cooked.
9. Enjoy it hot with any millet roti. I used bajra roti 😊

Save this reel & follow for more such balanced recipes ✅

1. Soak 1/2 cup mung for atleast 2 hours
2. Heat some oil in a pan & add jeera, mustard seeds & little hing (asafoetida)
3. Once it crackles, add garlic paste & let it cook for 30 secs
4. Time to add soaked mung & chopped spinach
5. Close the lid & let it cook for 5 minutes without stirring until the spinach reduces. You need not add water at this stage. Spinach will leave moisture & the dal will get cooked in that water.
6. Now add the spices - salt, turmeric, chili powder & coriander seeds powder.
7. Stir everything well, add little water & cover.
8. Let it cook for another 10 minutes or until the dal is cooked.
9. Enjoy it hot with any millet roti. I used bajra roti 😊

recipes.text: save this post and follow for more! crispy garlic parmesan crusted potatoes are back and better this year and if there is one thing you make this holiday season, let it be these. this side dish is super simple to whip together and are pretty much the only way i want to eat potatoes—crispy, crunchy, soft in the middle and covered in the parmesan cheese. eat straight from the tray or with a side of ketchup!⁣ ⁣ makes 6-8 servings⁣ 1 lb mini yukon gold potatoes, halved⁣ 2 tb olive oil⁣ 1 tb dried parsley⁣ 1 tb garlic powder⁣ 1/2 tsp salt⁣ 1/2 tsp ground black pepper⁣ 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted⁣ 1 1/2 cups freshly grated parmigiano reggiano ⁣ ⁣ preheat oven to 425 degrees f. wash potatoes and cut them in half. then, take a sharp knife and score them into a diamond shape. transfer the potatoes to a large bowl and toss with olive oil, parsley, garlic powder and salt. set aside. next, grate the parmigiano reggiano cheese. pour melted butter on top and mix until you get a thick paste. transfer the mixture to a large baking dish and spread into an even layer. take each potato half and press it into the cheese, cut side down. repeat until all potatoes are in the dish. bake for 25-26 minutes. remove from the oven. let the potatoes rest for 10 minutes so the cheese hardens and then take a spatula and remove from the pan. break into pieces and enjoy!⁣ ⁣
recipes.caption:
Save this post and follow @kalejunkie for more! CRISPY GARLIC PARMESAN CRUSTED POTATOES are back and better this year and if there is one thing you make this holiday season, let it be THESE. This side dish is super simple to whip together and are pretty much the only way I want to eat potatoes—crispy, crunchy, soft in the middle and covered in the parmesan cheese. Eat straight from the tray or with a side of ketchup!⁣
⁣
Makes 6-8 servings⁣
1 lb mini yukon gold potatoes, halved⁣
2 tb olive oil⁣
1 tb dried parsley⁣
1 tb garlic powder⁣
1/2 tsp salt⁣
1/2 tsp ground black pepper⁣
1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted⁣
1 1/2 cups freshly grated parmigiano reggiano ⁣
⁣
Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Wash potatoes and cut them in half. Then, take a sharp knife and score them into a diamond shape. Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl and toss with olive oil, parsley, garlic powder and salt. Set aside. Next, grate the parmigiano reggiano cheese. Pour melted butter on top and mix until you get a thick paste. Transfer the mixture to a large baking dish and spread into an even layer. Take each potato half and press it into the cheese, cut side down. Repeat until all potatoes are in the dish. Bake for 25-26 minutes. Remove from the oven. Let the potatoes rest for 10 minutes so the cheese hardens and then take a spatula and remove from the pan. Break into pieces and enjoy!⁣
⁣

Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl and toss with olive oil, parsley, garlic powder and salt. Set aside. Next, grate the parmigiano reggiano cheese. Pour melted butter on top and mix until you get a thick paste. Transfer the mixture to a large baking dish and spread into an even layer. Take each potato half and press it into the cheese, cut side down. Repeat until all potatoes are in the dish. Bake for 25-26 minutes. Remove from the oven. recipes.title: Upside-Down Apple Danish
recipes.author: healthy_floflo
recipes.text: 🍎⤵️upside down apple danish reasons to love this recipe: ✅ made with apple, so it is healthy.. isn’t it? ✅ the easiest puff pastry recipe you’ll make this holiday season💫 ✅ you only need 6 simple ingredients ingredients: 2 apples, sliced very thin 1 sheet puff pastry, cut into 8 rectangle pieces honey cinnamon 1 egg yolk powder sugar (to dust) instructions: 🍎on a baking tray add a sheet of baking paper. 🍎spoon or drizzle 6 tsp of honey on the baking paper, these needs to be very far apart. 🍎sprinkle cinnamon on top and as 4-5 slices of apple on top of each bit of honey. add another teaspoon of honey. 🍎add the puff pastry rectangle piece on top and press down the edges with a fork, to seal each rectangle. 🍎brush the top of the puff pastry with egg yolk. 🍎bake for 12 mins at 180c 🍎let it cool down and sprinkle some icing sugar. thank you enjoy💫
recipes.caption:
🍎⤵️Upside down Apple danish

Reasons to love this recipe:
✅ made with apple, so it is healthy.. isn’t it?
✅ the easiest puff pastry recipe you’ll make this holiday season💫
✅ you only need 6 simple ingredients 

Ingredients:
2 apples, sliced very thin
1 sheet Puff pastry, cut into 8 rectangle pieces
Honey 
Cinnamon
1 egg yolk
Powder sugar (to dust)

Instructions:
🍎On a baking tray add a sheet of baking paper.

🍎Spoon or drizzle 6 tsp of honey on the baking paper, these needs to be very far apart.

🍎Sprinkle cinnamon on top and as 4-5 slices of apple on top of each bit of honey. Add another teaspoon of honey. 

🍎Add the puff pastry rectangle piece on top and press down the edges with a fork, to seal each rectangle.

🍎Brush the top of the puff pastry with egg yolk.

🍎Bake for 12 mins at 180C

🍎Let it cool down and sprinkle some icing sugar.

Thank you @feelgoofoodie 

Enjoy💫

recipes.recipe_method:
On a baking tray add a sheet of baking paper.
Spoon or drizzle 6 tsp of honey on the baking paper, these needs to be very far apart.
Sprinkle cinnamon on top and as 4-5 slices of apple on top of each bit of honey. Add another teaspoon of honey.
Add the puff pastry rectangle piece on top and press down the edges with a fork, to seal each rectangle.
Brush the top of the puff pastry with egg yolk.
Bake for 12 mins at 180C
Let it cool down and sprinkle some icing sugar.

recipes.caption:
Here’s the breakfast you should eat if you want to boost gut health.

My onsen egg and miso probiotic breakfast soup.

You’ll find pho in Vietnam, Caldo de Costilla in Colombia, jook in China, juk in Korea. Soup is what many long-living cultures around the world eat for breakfast, and in Japan it’s miso soup.

It’s a stark difference from the fried eggs and preserved sausages or cold sugary cereals you’d find on most breakfast plates here in the US.

If you’ve been following me, you’ll already know that I love cooking in broth because it produces the least amount of the aging compounds called advanced glycation end products (AGEs). AGEs not only kick off inflammation in our bodies but also destroy everything from our DNA to our skin.

Why should we care about probiotics and gut health? 

We now know there is a strong connection between our gut and our immunity, metabolism, our brains (there is a gut-brain axis), our skin (gut-skin axis). The little bugs are the foundation of everything.

Probiotic Breakfast Miso Soup
 
Ingredients:
Dashi (premade dashi packet or see below for homemade)
Onsen egg (See my two other onsen egg recipes)
Greens - I chose mizuna, a mustard green and cruciferous veggie, but you can use kale, bok choy, any sprouts
Green onions, sliced thinly
Miso paste (preferably organic)
Wakame seaweed
Soft tofu, cubed

Directions:
1. Place a small amount of miso paste (about 1/2 tsp) into a bowl and mix with a bit of the hot dashi broth. Stir until it’s uniform throughout. 
2. Crack open an onsen egg into the miso-broth mixture.
3. Sprinkle dried wakame seaweed and pour broth on top.
4. Layer the rest of the soup ingredients: greens, tofu, green onions

Dashi recipe:
Kombu seaweed and Katsuoboshi (dried bonito flakes)

Place 1-2 kombu strips of seaweed into a pot of  4 cups of cold water and let it sit about 20 minutes. Heat the water on medium low and turn off once the water is almost boiling. Remove the kombu and add 1 cup of katsuoboshi and bring it back to a boil, then let it simmer and turn off the heat. Wait until the bonito flakes sink to the bottom then strain the dashi broth.

Enjoy!

Have you ever had breakfast soup?

xo Dr. Michelle

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Skewers
recipes.author: canyoucookuk
recipes.text: easy air fryer recipes (day 2) garlic parmesan chicken skewers 🍗 these air fried chicken skewers are super quick to make & takes less than 20 minutes! the garlic butter sauce brings the perfect balance & tastes unreal 🤤 recipe below 👇🏻 ingredients - 5 chicken thighs (diced) spices: - 1 tsp salt - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1/2 tsp black pepper - 1 tsp paprika - 1 tsp onion powder - olive oil sauce: - 1 tbsp butter - 2 garlic cloves minced - 1/2 tsp red chilli flakes - chopped parsley - freshly grated parmesan (as much as you want) method - marinate the chicken & thread it onto wooden skewers that are pre soaked in water. - prepare the sauce by adding all the ingredients in a pot or pan and cook for 3-4 mins until the butter is completely melted. - air fry for 7 mins on one side. then brush the garlic butter sauce on it & flip and air fry for 7 more mins. - once done, take the skewers out and brush more sauce on top as well as sprinkle parmesan. enjoy! . . .
recipes.caption:
EASY AIR FRYER RECIPES (DAY 2)

#howtomake Garlic Parmesan Chicken Skewers 🍗 

These air fried chicken skewers are super quick to make & takes less than 20 minutes! The garlic butter sauce brings the perfect balance & tastes UNREAL 🤤 Recipe below 👇🏻 

INGREDIENTS 
- 5 Chicken thighs (diced) 
Spices:
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp garlic powder 
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1 tsp paprika 
- 1 tsp onion powder 
- Olive oil
Sauce:
- 1 tbsp butter
- 2 garlic cloves minced 
- 1/2 tsp red chilli flakes 
- Chopped parsley 
- Freshly grated parmesan (as much as you want) 

METHOD
- Marinate the chicken & thread it onto wooden skewers that are pre soaked in water. 
- Prepare the sauce by adding all the ingredients in a pot or pan and cook for 3-4 mins until the butter is completely melted. 
- Air fry for 7 mins on one side. Then brush the garlic butter sauce on it & flip and air fry for 7 more mins.
- Once done, take the skewers out and brush more sauce on top as well as sprinkle parmesan. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Fondant Potatoes
recipes.author: kellyscleankitchen
recipes.text: how to make fondant potatoes ⬇️ who is making these for christmas??? follow for more cooking tutorials and recipes! fondant potatoes are a traditional french side dish where you cut russet potatoes into rounds or squares and then cook in butter, garlic, aromatics and chicken stock. it is a dish you won’t find too often these days, but is impressive and delicious to all guests you may be cooking for. ingredients: * 4 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch rounds * 10 garlic cloves, smashed * salt and pepper * avocado oil * 4 tbsp butter * 2 sprigs rosemary * 4 sprigs thyme * 1/2 cup chicken stock instructions: step 1. peel potatoes, trim ends, and cut in half crosswise. you should now have 8 flat potato rounds. place in a large bowl and cover with cold water. soak for 20 minutes. step 2. arrange oven rack in the middle of the oven at 400*f. step 3. drain the potatoes, rinse with cold water and pat dry on paper towels. season with salt and pepper. step 4. heat oil in a pan over medium high heat. add potatoes, cut side down and brown for 7 minutes. flip and add garlic, butter, thyme, and rosemary. cook until butter is foaming and starts to brown, 2-3 minutes. add chicken stock so potatoes are half submerged. bring to a simmer. step 5. transfer to the oven and bake until the potatoes are fork tender and lightly browned on all sides, 15-20 minutes
recipes.caption:
How to make fondant potatoes ⬇️ who is making these for Christmas???

Follow @kellyscleankitchen for more cooking tutorials and recipes!

Fondant potatoes are a traditional French side dish where you cut russet potatoes into rounds or squares and then cook in butter, garlic, aromatics and chicken stock. It is a dish you won’t find too often these days, but is impressive and delicious to all guests you may be cooking for.

Ingredients:
* 4 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch rounds
* 10 garlic cloves, smashed
* salt and pepper
* avocado oil
* 4 tbsp butter
* 2 sprigs rosemary
* 4 sprigs thyme
* 1/2 cup chicken stock

Instructions:

STEP 1.
Peel potatoes, trim ends, and cut in half crosswise. You should now have 8 flat potato rounds. Place in a large bowl and cover with cold water. Soak for 20 minutes.

STEP 2.
Arrange oven rack in the middle of the oven at 400*F.

STEP 3.
Drain the potatoes, rinse with cold water and pat dry on paper towels. Season with salt and pepper.

STEP 4.
Heat oil in a pan over medium high heat. Add potatoes, cut side down and brown for 7 minutes. Flip and add garlic, butter, thyme, and rosemary. Cook until butter is foaming and starts to brown, 2-3 minutes. Add chicken stock so potatoes are half submerged. Bring to a simmer.

STEP 5.
Transfer to the oven and bake until the potatoes are fork tender and lightly browned on all sides, 15-20 minutes

Heat oil in a pan over medium high heat. Add potatoes, cut side down and brown for 7 minutes. Flip and add garlic, butter, thyme, and rosemary. Cook until butter is foaming and starts to brown, 2-3 minutes. Add chicken stock so potatoes are half submerged. Bring to a simmer.
STEP 5.
Transfer to the oven and bake until the potatoes are fork tender and lightly browned on all sides, 15-20 minutes

Healthy fish tacos✨

For the Pickled Onions:▪️1 Thin Sliced Red Onion▪️1 Cup White Vinegar▪️1 Cup Water▪️2 Tbsp Sugar▪️2 tsp Kosher Salt▪️

For the Sauce + Slaw:▪️3/4 Cup Greek Yogurt▪️1/4 Cup Light Sour Cream▪️3 Tbsp Cilantro, minced▪️1 Clove Garlic, grated or minced▪️2 Limes, juice▪️ 2 Tbsp Water▪️1/4 tsp Salt▪️3 Cups Red Cabbage▪️

For the Tacos:▪️1 lb. Tilapia (or other white fish)▪️1+1/2 tsp Chili Powder▪️1+1/2 tsp Cumin▪️1/2 tsp Garlic Powder▪️1 tsp Salt▪️1 tsp Olive Oil▪️6-8 Cassava Flour Tortillas (I love @sietefoods, but any tortilla will work)▪️1 Avocado, sliced▪️1/2 Jalapeño, seeds removed and diced small▪️

1️⃣ First make the pickled onions: Place onions in a heat safe bowl (or jar) and set aside; add the vinegar, water, sugar, and salt to a small pot and bring to a simmer; stir so the  sugar and salt dissolves; pour the liquid over the onions and let sit at room temp while you prep the other ingredients (or if you can wait an hour that's best!)
2️⃣ Mix together the ingredients for the sauce and set 1/4 cup aside (to serve on top of the tacos); mix the rest of the sauce with the slaw ingredients
3️⃣ Place the  chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt in a large shallow bowl and then coat both sides of each piece of fish in the spice blend (press the spices on with your fingers if needed)
4️⃣ Heat up a pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp olive oil; add the tilapia and cook 3-4 mins per side until internal temp reaches 145F; turn off the heat and break the fish into pieces (I like to serve the fish in the hot pan so it stays sizzling hot)
5️⃣ Heat up your tortillas in a hot pan for ~30 sec per side; top each tortilla with some slaw, fish, pickled onions, jalapeño, a slice of avocado and some additional yogurt sauce - enjoy!

⏲35 minute prep time + 10 minute cook time

Recipe serves 2 people (makes ~6 tacos)

For the Pickled Onions:

For the Sauce + Slaw:

1/4 Cup Light Sour Cream
3 Tbsp Cilantro, minced
1 Clove Garlic, grated or minced
2 Limes, juice
2 Tbsp Water
1/4 tsp Salt
3 Cups Red Cabbage
For the Tacos:
1 lb. Tilapia (or other white fish)
1+1/2 tsp Chili Powder
1+1/2 tsp Cumin

6-8 Cassava Flour Tortillas (I love @sietefoods, but any tortilla will work)

recipes.recipe_method:
First make the pickled onions: Place onions in a heat safe bowl (or jar) and set aside; add the vinegar, water, sugar, and salt to a small pot and bring to a simmer; stir so the  sugar and salt dissolves; pour the liquid over the onions and let sit at room temp while you prep the other ingredients (or if you can wait an hour that's best!)
Mix together the ingredients for the sauce and set 1/4 cup aside (to serve on top of the tacos); mix the rest of the sauce with the slaw ingredients
Place the  chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt in a large shallow bowl and then coat both sides of each piece of fish in the spice blend (press the spices on with your fingers if needed)
Heat up a pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp olive oil; add the tilapia and cook 3-4 mins per side until internal temp reaches 145F; turn off the heat and break the fish into pieces (I like to serve the fish in the hot pan so it stays sizzling hot)
Heat up your tortillas in a hot pan for ~30 sec per side; top each tortilla with some slaw, fish, pickled onions, jalapeño, a slice of avocado and some additional yogurt sauce - enjoy!

recipes.text: our garlic bread brie is definitely worth making and so easy! we infused the flavors of garlic bread into baked brie and think we might need to make this appetizer all the time now. so simple and so good. full recipe below! garlic bread brie serves 8 ingredients: garlic butter: 4 tablespoons salted butter, softened 1 tablespoon grated parmesan 1/2 tablespoon minced parsley 1/2 tablespoon thinly sliced chives, plus more for garnish 1 minced garlic clove 1/8 teaspoon black pepper 8 ounce wheel brie, top rind scored into a crosshatch 1. preheat oven to 350˚f. 2. spread an even layer of garlic butter over the scored brie and transfer brie to a baking dish. 3. bake brie for 12 to 14 minutes or until butter has melted and brie is soft. 4. top brie with more sliced chives and serve with crackers and/or crostini.
recipes.caption:
Our Garlic Bread Brie is DEFINITELY worth making and so easy! We infused the flavors of garlic bread into baked brie and think we might need to make this appetizer all the time now. So simple and so good. Full recipe below! 
Garlic Bread Brie
Serves 8

Ingredients:
garlic butter:
4 tablespoons salted butter, softened
1 tablespoon grated Parmesan
1/2 tablespoon minced parsley
1/2 tablespoon thinly sliced chives, plus more for garnish
1 minced garlic clove
1/8 teaspoon black pepper

8 ounce wheel brie, top rind scored into a crosshatch
