recipes.caption:
This plate to plane is lemon chicken, a quick elegant meal that can also make meal prep not feel so bland. Simple ingredients with big taste. You can’t beat it. 

If you’re PCOS conscious, your follicular phase includes lemon, chicken, and parsley! We served with some steamed broccoli (also follicular) with fresh lemon juice.  it’s GF & DF

Ingredients
* 4 chicken breasts pounded to about 1/4 inch and even
* 1/2 cup almond flour
* 1 tablespoon arrowroot
* 1 lemon zested and divided in half
* 2 tablespoons olive oil more as needed
* 1 tablespoon butter
* Salt & pepper to taste

Sauce
* 2 tablespoon butter
* 1 cup chicken broth
* 1/2 lemon zest
* 1 garlic clove minced
* 1 lemon juiced (about 2-3 tablespoons)
* 2 tablespoons fresh parsley chopped

Instructions:

1. Combine the flour, arrow root, 1/2 lemon zest, salt and pepper. Dredge the chicken in mixture
2. Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter over medium high heat and cook chicken about 4-5 minutes per side or until just until cooked through. Cook in batches if you cannot fit into pan.  Remove from pan, leave juice and bits behind and place on a plate.
3. In the same pan, reduce heat to medium and add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 min. 
4. Add chicken broth and scrap any brown bits from the pan. Those have huge flavor! Add lemon juice. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Reduce by half, about 2 minutes 
5. Add 2 tbsp butter and lemon zest. Stir to melt butter
6. Return chicken to skillet, spoon sauce over chicken. Allow chicken to absorb the flavor. Garnish with parsley and a lemon wedge.

recipes.recipe_ingredients:
Thandai Masala
10 – 12 Almonds, blanched and peeled
10 – 12 Cashews
10 – 12 Raisins
10 – 12 Cardamom Pods
25 – 30 Black Peppercorns
1 Teaspoon Poppy Seeds
1 ½ Teaspoons Fennel Seeds
2 Teaspoons Melon Seeds
Thandai Milk
3 Cups Whole Milk, use full fat for best results
2 Pinches Saffron
⅓ Cup Sugar
1 Tablespoon Rose Water
recipes.recipe_method:
Thandai Masala
Grind all the masala ingredients to a coarse powder and set aside.
Thandai Milk
Heat the milk in a heavy bottomed pot and bring to a boil. Once the milk boils, reduce the heat to low and simmer.
Meanwhile, crush the saffron in a bowl. Add a ladle full of hot milk to it, and set aside to use later.
Add all the thandai masala to the pot of simmering milk and mix. Continue to heat on low and add the sugar. Keep stirring and cooking till the sugar dissolves, about 2-3 minutes. Turn off the flame and allow the milk mixture to rest for 30 minutes.
Add the saffron milk mix and the rosewater to the thandai milk pot and combine. Allow to rest for another 30 minutes.
Strain the milk into a bottle or jug using a fine sieve or strainer. Press down the masala in the strainer using the back of a spoon to ensure you extract as much of the masala flavour as possible.
Chill the thandai in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight. Always serve chilled!

recipes.recipe_ingredients:
Broth Ingredients
½ pineapple cut into large chunks
1 large jicama cut into cubes
2 Granny Smith apples seeds removed
1 Daikon radish roughly chopped
3 carrots roughly chopped
2 large leeks reserve the white part
10 stalks lemongrass reserve the white part
40 g rock sugar
20 cups water
umami seasoning or mushrooms seasoning
salt to taste
Annatto Oil
2 tablespoons Annatto seeds
5 tablespoons oil
Filling Ingredients
14 oz firm tofu pressed, cut into cubes, and pan-fried
¼-½ cup white part of leek
¼-½ cup the white part of the lemongrass
1 cup King oyster mushrooms sliced
2 tablespoons chili flakes more for a spicier broth
umami seasoning
Pairing Ingredients (Herbs and Garnishes)
Thai basil
Mung bean sprouts
Shredded green cabbage
Shredded purple cabbage
Water spinach stems
Green onions
Cilantro
Vietnamese coriander
Banana flower
Jalapenô slices
recipes.recipe_method:
Make the Broth
Prepare the lemongrass; remove the outer layer, and finely chop the white part and reserve the stalk for soup. Repeat the same step for leek.
Use the back of the knife or pestle to pound the lemongrass to release its flavor.
Then, place all the broth ingredients in a large pot except the umami seasoning.
Bring the mixture to a rolling boil, then lower the heat to medium and cook for an hour. Feel free to use an Instant pot to reduce the cooking time.
When ready, discard the ingredients and season to taste with mushrooms seasoning or Yondu.
Annatto Oil
Heat a small pot with oil. Add in the annatto seeds and stir until the oil turns red.
Sieve to discard the seeds and reserve the oil for cooking.
How to prepare the filling ingredients
Heat a small pan, add in the annatto oil, then sauté leek and lemongrass until fragrant.
Add in the mushrooms, tofu, chili flakes, and season to taste.
Transfer this mixture into the prepared broth and cook for another 10-15 minutes to release its flavor. You may reserve some filling as toppings as well.
How to serve
To put everything together, cook noodles as directed and place them into a bowl.
Ladle hot soup over the noodles and garnish with suggested pairings. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Schezwan Veg Fried Rice
recipes.author: cookdtv
recipes.text: schezwan veg fried rice is a popular indo chinese recipe. with every spoonful of rice, you will feel the taste bursting with flavors😍 schezwan veg fried rice recipe: basmati rice - 1 cup water - 4 cups oil - 1 tbsp butter - 1 tsp garlic - 3 cloves dried red chilli - 1 no onion - 1 no carrot - 1 no beans - 7 nos capsicum - ½ no schezwan sauce - 2 tbsp celery leaves - 1 tbsp spring onion - 2 tbsp salt - to taste sugar - ½ tsp black pepper powder - ¼ tsp vinegar - ½ tsp soy sauce - ½ tsp cooking instructions: 1. wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 mins. 2. cook the basmati rice in an open pot with 1 litre of water and ¼ tsp of salt. once the rice is 80% done, drain the water and let the rice cool completely. 3. in a pan, add oil, butter, finely chopped garlic cloves, red torn into half, finely chopped onions, carrots, beans and capsicum. saute this for 3 mins. 4. add the schezwan sauce and continue to saute for another 1 minute. 5. add the cooked rice to the pan. 6. ass soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper. 7. increase the flame to high and stir fry the rice by tossing it. 8. add the spring onion and celery leaves and continue to stir fry. 9. remove from heat and serve hot.
recipes.caption:
Schezwan Veg Fried Rice is a popular Indo Chinese recipe.
With every spoonful of rice, you will feel the taste bursting with flavors😍

Schezwan Veg Fried Rice Recipe:

Basmati Rice - 1 Cup
Water - 4 Cups
Oil - 1 tbsp
Butter - 1 tsp
Garlic - 3 Cloves
Dried Red Chilli - 1 no
Onion - 1 no
Carrot - 1 no
Beans - 7 nos
Capsicum - ½ no
Schezwan Sauce - 2 tbsp
Celery Leaves - 1 tbsp
Spring Onion - 2 tbsp
Salt - To Taste
Sugar - ½ tsp
Black Pepper Powder - ¼ tsp
Vinegar - ½ tsp
Soy Sauce - ½ tsp

Cooking Instructions:

1. Wash and Soak the Basmati Rice for 30 mins.

2. Cook the Basmati rice in an open pot with 1 litre of water and ¼ tsp of salt. Once the rice is 80% done, drain the water and let the rice cool completely.

3. In a pan, add oil, butter, finely chopped garlic cloves, red torn into half, finely chopped onions, carrots, beans and capsicum. Saute this for 3 mins.

4. Add the Schezwan sauce and continue to saute for another 1 minute.

5. Add the cooked rice to the pan.

6. Ass soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.

7. Increase the flame to high and stir fry the rice by tossing it.

8. Add the spring onion and celery leaves and continue to stir fry.

9. Remove from heat and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chum Chum
recipes.author: twistie_bites
recipes.text: yummy chum chum 😍 tasty mithai bnao iss easy recipe se 😍 . . instructions 1. in a kadhai add 1 cup suji(semolina) and dry roast it for 2-3 mins without changing its color. 2. now add 1 cup of milk in small quantities with continuous stirring.mix well to form a dough. 3. transfer the dough to a plate and let it come to room temperature. 4. grease your hand and knead the dough well. 5. now add 2 tbsp milk powder, 2 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp dessicated coconut. mix and knead it again for 3-4 mins. 6. take a portion of dough and roll to form a cylindrical shape. ensure that there shouldn't be any crack. 7. in a kadhai, add 3/4 cup of sugar , 1 elaichi and 1 cup of water. 8. mix well and let it cook to form sugar syrup of sticky consistency. 9. place all the rolls in the sugar syrup. cover and let it cook on low flame. 10. turn off the flame and let it remain untouched for 10-15 mins. 11. take each roll and coat it with dessicated coconut. 12. place all the coated rolls in a plate. 13. garnish with pistachios or your favourite dryfruits. 14. chum chum is ready. . . . . no repost without permission 🚫❌ follow follow for more mouth watering updates ❤️ . .
recipes.caption:
Yummy Chum Chum 😍
Tasty mithai bnao iss easy recipe se 😍
.

Instructions
1. In a kadhai add 1 cup suji(semolina) and dry roast it for 2-3 mins without changing its color.
2. Now add 1 cup of milk in small quantities with continuous stirring.Mix well to form a dough.
3. Transfer the dough to a plate and let it come to room temperature.
4. Grease your hand and knead the dough well.
5. Now add 2 tbsp milk powder, 2 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp dessicated coconut. Mix and knead it again for 3-4 mins.
6. Take a portion of dough and roll to form a cylindrical shape. Ensure that there shouldn't be any crack.
7. In a kadhai, add 3/4 cup of sugar , 1 elaichi and 1 cup of water. 
8. Mix well and let it cook to form sugar syrup of sticky consistency. 
9. Place all the rolls in the sugar syrup. Cover and let it cook on low flame.
10. Turn off the flame and let it remain untouched for 10-15 mins.
11. Take each roll and coat it with dessicated coconut.
12. Place all the coated rolls in a plate. 
13. Garnish with Pistachios or your favourite dryfruits.
14. Chum Chum is ready.

recipes.recipe_method:
1. In a kadhai add 1 cup suji(semolina) and dry roast it for 2-3 mins without changing its color.
2. Now add 1 cup of milk in small quantities with continuous stirring.Mix well to form a dough.
3. Transfer the dough to a plate and let it come to room temperature.
4. Grease your hand and knead the dough well.
5. Now add 2 tbsp milk powder, 2 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp dessicated coconut. Mix and knead it again for 3-4 mins.
6. Take a portion of dough and roll to form a cylindrical shape. Ensure that there shouldn't be any crack.
7. In a kadhai, add 3/4 cup of sugar , 1 elaichi and 1 cup of water.
8. Mix well and let it cook to form sugar syrup of sticky consistency.
9. Place all the rolls in the sugar syrup. Cover and let it cook on low flame.
10. Turn off the flame and let it remain untouched for 10-15 mins.
11. Take each roll and coat it with dessicated coconut.
12. Place all the coated rolls in a plate.
13. Garnish with Pistachios or your favourite dryfruits.
14. Chum Chum is ready.

recipes.title: Baked Methi Mathri
recipes.author: cookwithmanali
recipes.text: baked methi mathri- always a popular recipe this time of the year! 😊 these mathri are flavored with kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves), ajwain (carom seeds), sesame seeds and bunch of more spices! so easy to make too! these are reader’s favorite during diwali and hope they will be on your menu this time around too! 🙌 click link in profile for the recipe. . . . . . . .

recipes.recipe_ingredients:
1.5 cups atta (whole wheat flour), 195 grams
1/2 cup besan (gram flour), 52 grams
2 tablespoons kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves), slightly crushed
1/4 teaspoon red chili powder, or adjust to taste
1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder
3/4 teaspoon ajwain (carom seeds)
1 teaspoon sesame seeds
1 teaspoon salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon baking powder
1/3 cup olive oil or ghee, 80 ml, or use oil of choice
water, to knead the dough, little more than 1/2 cup
recipes.recipe_method:
To a large bowl add atta (whole wheat flour) and besan (gram flour). Now add to it all the seasonings - kasuri methi, red chili powder, turmeric, ajwain (carom seeds), sesame seeds, salt and baking powder.
Mix to combine it all together. Add oil (or ghee) and mix it well with the flour using your hands (rub the flour between your palms to incorporate the oil).
The oil should be well incorporated into the flour. The mixture will turn crumbly.
Now, start adding water little by little to knead the dough.
Once the dough comes together, knead it for 5 minutes. I used my stand mixer to knead it. Cover and rest the dough for 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile pre-heat the oven to 375 F degrees.
After the dough has rested, divide it into 2 parts. Take one part of the dough and roll it, around 1/4 inch thick.
Now you can either use cookie cutter or pizza cutter to shape the mathri. I simply cut some into squares (1.75 inch x 1.75 inch) using my pizza cutter and also some circles (2 inches diameter) using my cookie cutter.
Using a fork poke the mathris so that they don’t rise much while baking. Repeat with the remaining dough.
Place the squares/rounds on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or silicone mat. Leave a little space between each mathri.
Bake at 375 F degrees for 20-22 minutes, flipping them once half-way. I usually bake around 23-24 minutes since I like quite crispy mathris. If you don’t like super crispy, bake around 20 minutes.
Let cool and then store baked methi mathri in an airtight container.
If you roll the mathri thick, they will take more time to bake so keep that in mind.

recipes.recipe_ingredients:
1.25 cups kesar pista shrikhand
6 cookies, I used biscoff cookies
1 tablespoon unsalted butter, melted & slightly cooled
4 gulab jamuns, cut in half
nuts, edible silver leaves, optional, to garnish & decorate
recipes.recipe_method:
Make shrikhand beforehand. You can either use my homemade recipe or any that you like.
Add cookies to a food processor. I have used biscoff cookies here, you can use any cookie that you like.
Pulse to crush the cookies and then transfer them to a bowl.
Add melted butter to the bowl and mix it with the cookies until the mixture resembles crumbs. If using cookies which aren’t very sweet, you might need to add some sugar along with the butter into the cookie crumbs.
Now take the jars and add around 2 teaspoons cookie crumbs in each serving glass. Press lightly using your fingers.
Pipe shrikhand into the jars above the cookie crust. I have used a piping bag here, you can simply use a spoon.
Cut the gulab jamuns into half and top each jars with cut jamun.
Repeat with remaining jars. Place the jars in the refrigerator to chill for few hours. Shrikhand becomes thick as it chills so it’s important to chill.
Once chilled, serve immediately. You may garnish with nuts or decorate with edible silver leaves!

recipes.title: Delhi Style Aloo Chaat
recipes.author: my_foodstory
recipes.text: i like to think that i’m something of an expert on chaat and street food. i stick up my nose at bad chaat and i can’t help it. i’ve grown up eating the best stuff, at home and outside. and i can’t have that taste violated.⁠ ⁠ this delhi style aloo chaat is standard snacking on sunday evenings, holidays, festivals and we’ve sort of perfected the flavours.⁠ ⁠ bookmark this recipe:⁠ ⁠ ⁠ 4 medium sized potatoes, boiled and peeled⁠ 3–4 tablespoon ghee for shallow frying⁠ 1 1/2 teaspoons roasted cumin powder⁠ 1 teaspoon chaat masala⁠ 1 teaspoon red chilli powder (or paprika)⁠ 1/2 teaspoon dry mango powder/ amchur⁠ 1/2 teaspoon rock salt (kala namak)⁠ 1/2 teaspoon salt⁠ 1 1/2 teaspoon lime juice⁠ 2 tablespoons sweet tamarind chutney⁠ 1 small onion, sliced⁠ a few coriander leaves⁠ 1/4 cup nylon sev (optional)⁠ ⁠ ⁠ slice the potatoes, or cut them in half lengthwise.⁠ heat ghee in a skillet or tawa. place the potatoes on the skillet (make sure they are not overlapping/ fry them in batches if required) and let them fry on low heat, turning once or twice, till golden brown and crisp on both sides.⁠ transfer the fried potatoes to a bowl and sprinkle all the masalas and salts on top and toss to mix. add the lemon juice and toss again. taste to check seasoning and add more chili powder or salt as required.⁠ arrange them on a serving platter or large plate and drizzle with tamarind chutney, sliced onions, coriander and nylon sev.⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠
recipes.caption:
I like to think that I’m something of an expert on chaat and street food. I stick up my nose at bad chaat and I can’t help it. I’ve grown up eating the best stuff, at home and outside. And I can’t have that taste violated.⁠
⁠
This Delhi style aloo chaat is standard snacking on Sunday evenings, holidays, festivals and we’ve sort of perfected the flavours.⁠
⁠
Bookmark this recipe:⁠
⁠
⁠
4 medium sized potatoes, boiled and peeled⁠
3–4 tablespoon ghee for shallow frying⁠
1 1/2 teaspoons roasted cumin powder⁠
1 teaspoon chaat masala⁠
1 teaspoon red chilli powder (or paprika)⁠
1/2 teaspoon dry mango powder/ amchur⁠
1/2 teaspoon rock salt (kala namak)⁠
1/2 teaspoon salt⁠
1 1/2 teaspoon lime juice⁠
2 tablespoons sweet tamarind chutney⁠
1 small onion, sliced⁠
a few coriander leaves⁠
1/4 cup nylon sev (optional)⁠
⁠
⁠
Slice the potatoes, or cut them in half lengthwise.⁠
Heat ghee in a skillet or tawa. Place the potatoes on the skillet (make sure they are not overlapping/ fry them in batches if required) and let them fry on low heat, turning once or twice, till golden brown and crisp on both sides.⁠
Transfer the fried potatoes to a bowl and sprinkle all the masalas and salts on top and toss to mix. Add the lemon juice and toss again. Taste to check seasoning and add more chili powder or salt as required.⁠
Arrange them on a serving platter or large plate and drizzle with tamarind chutney, sliced onions, coriander and nylon sev.⁠

recipes.recipe_ingredients:
4 medium sized potatoes, boiled and peeled
3–4 tablespoon ghee for shallow frying
1 1/2 teaspoons roasted cumin powder
1 teaspoon chaat masala
1 teaspoon red chilli powder (or paprika)
1/2 teaspoon dry mango powder/ amchur
1/2 teaspoon rock salt (kala namak)
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 1/2 teaspoon lime juice
2 tablespoons sweet tamarind chutney
1 small onion, sliced
a few coriander leaves
1/4 cup nylon sev (optional)
recipes.recipe_method:
Slice the potatoes, or cut them in half lengthwise.
Heat ghee in a skillet or tawa. Place the potatoes on the skillet (make sure they are not overlapping/ fry them in batches if required) and let them fry on low heat, turning once or twice, till golden brown and crisp on both sides.
Transfer the fried potatoes to a bowl and sprinkle all the masalas and salts on top and toss to mix. Add the lemon juice and toss again. Taste to check seasoning and add more chili powder or salt as required.
Arrange them on a serving platter or large plate and drizzle with tamarind chutney, sliced onions, coriander and nylon sev.

recipes.title: Salted Caramel Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.author: milkandcardamom
recipes.text: 🍪 apparently, it's today, so clearly i need to share my favorite dessert, the cookie, and the science behind why this recipe is so good! this salted caramel chocolate chip cookie recipe is adapted from famous chocolate chip recipe. it made with bread flour, a high-protein flour which means you’ll have more gluten leading to a chewier cookie, and cake flour, a low protein flour, which gives you a softer texture. mixing them gives you a cookie that is chewy on the outside and soft in the middle! this recipe also requires resting the dough in the fridge for 36 hours. first, resting the dough loosens the gluten and makes a softer cookie. second, the dough hydrates evenly, which leads to an even bake. eggs have a hard time hydrating flour because it’s thick and the butter has coated the flour molecules, preventing the egg from getting to it. the longer you rest it, the more egg hydrates the flour. you can substitute the eggs with applesauce and reduce your wait time to 24 hours. 🥛 what’s your favorite cookie? p.s enjoy another throwback song all about sweets! . . . . 🍪
recipes.caption:
🍪 Apparently, it's #NationalDessertDay today, so clearly I need to share my favorite dessert, the cookie, and the science behind why this recipe is so good! This salted caramel chocolate chip cookie recipe is adapted from @jacquestorres famous chocolate chip recipe. It made with bread flour, a high-protein flour which means you’ll have more gluten leading to a chewier cookie, and cake flour,  a low protein flour, which gives you a softer texture. Mixing them gives you a cookie that is chewy on the outside and soft in the middle! This recipe also requires resting the dough in the fridge for 36 hours. First, resting the dough loosens the gluten and makes a softer cookie. Second, the dough hydrates evenly, which leads to an even bake. Eggs have a hard time hydrating flour because it’s thick and the butter has coated the flour molecules, preventing the egg from getting to it. The longer you rest it, the more egg hydrates the flour. You can substitute the eggs with applesauce and reduce your wait time to 24 hours. 🥛 what’s your favorite cookie? P.S Enjoy another throwback song all about sweets!

recipes.title: Paparizza Garlic Bread
recipes.author: kuljyoti.dhingra
recipes.text: paparizza styled garlic bread recipe. . ingredients :- for dough :- dissolve 1 tsp sugar, 10 gms of yeast into 4 tbsp lukewarm water. now knead together 400 gms of all purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1.5 tsp milk powder, 2 tsp oil and yeast mix that we prepared. knead it atleast for 20 minutes and let it rest atleast for 2 hours. . for garlic butter :- add 1 tbsp pizza seasoning and 1 tbsp garlic in into 4 3 tbsp butter. . cheese sauce on a medium flame, add 2 tbsp of oil in the pan and then add 1 tbsp all purpose flour, mix it well and then add 1 cup milk and cook it until it thickens. now add 1/2 cup cheese (i have used amul's cheddar and mozarella cheese cubes) and some salt, pepper and pizza seasoning. . baking time preheat the oven at 230°c for 10 minutes, then bake this at 230°c for 12 minutes and at grill mode for 2 minutes. . .
recipes.caption:
Paparizza Styled Garlic Bread Recipe. 
.
Ingredients :-

For dough :-
Dissolve 1 tsp Sugar, 10 gms of Yeast into 4 tbsp lukewarm water. 
Now knead together 400 Gms of All Purpose Flour, 1 tsp salt, 1.5 tsp milk powder, 2 tsp oil and yeast mix that we prepared. Knead it atleast for 20 minutes and let it rest atleast for 2 hours. 
.
For Garlic Butter :-
Add 1 tbsp pizza seasoning and 1 tbsp Garlic in into 4 3 tbsp butter. 
.
Cheese Sauce
On a medium flame, add 2 tbsp of oil in the pan and then add 1 tbsp all purpose flour, mix it well and then add 1 cup milk and cook it until it thickens. Now add 1/2 cup cheese (I have used Amul's cheddar and mozarella cheese cubes) and some salt, pepper and pizza seasoning. 
.
Baking Time
Preheat the oven at 230°C for 10 minutes, then bake this at 230°C for 12 minutes and at grill mode for 2 minutes. 
.

recipes.recipe_method:
For dough :-
Dissolve 1 tsp Sugar, 10 gms of Yeast into 4 tbsp lukewarm water.
Now knead together 400 Gms of All Purpose Flour, 1 tsp salt, 1.5 tsp milk powder, 2 tsp oil and yeast mix that we prepared. Knead it atleast for 20 minutes and let it rest atleast for 2 hours.
For Garlic Butter :-
Add 1 tbsp pizza seasoning and 1 tbsp Garlic in into 4 3 tbsp butter.
Cheese Sauce
On a medium flame, add 2 tbsp of oil in the pan and then add 1 tbsp all purpose flour, mix it well and then add 1 cup milk and cook it until it thickens. Now add 1/2 cup cheese (I have used Amul's cheddar and mozarella cheese cubes) and some salt, pepper and pizza seasoning.
Baking Time
Preheat the oven at 230°C for 10 minutes, then bake this at 230°C for 12 minutes and at grill mode for 2 minutes.

recipes.text: methi malai matar i am not a big fan of this dish and green peas...however this turned out to be amazing! recipe>>> 1) boil green peas in salted water and drain the water. 2) in a pan boil sliced onions, chopped ginger and garlic. once boiled and cool, add to blender. 3) also add chopped tomatoes, cashew nuts, green chillies and blend till the whole mixture is smooth. 4) heat oil in a pan and add cinnamon, cloves, cardamom. 5) add the onion tomato paste and cook for 5-7 min. 6) now add kashmiri red chilli powder, turmeric and garam masala and cook for another 3-4 min. 7) add water and let it come to a boil. now add the methi and cook for 3-4 min. after this add the green peas and mix well. 8) add water and salt as per your desired consistency and taste. 9) also add a little sugar. now let the flame be on simmer and add milk and some fresh cream. keep stirring so that it doesn’t separate. 10) cook for 3 min and it is ready to eat😃
recipes.caption:
Methi Malai Matar

I am not a big fan of this dish and green peas...however this turned out to be amazing! 

Recipe>>>

1) Boil green peas in salted water and drain the water.
2) In a pan boil sliced onions, chopped ginger and garlic. Once boiled and cool, add to blender.
3) Also add chopped tomatoes, cashew nuts, green chillies and blend till the whole mixture is smooth.
4) Heat oil in a pan and add cinnamon, cloves, cardamom.
5) Add the onion tomato paste and cook for 5-7 min.
6) Now add Kashmiri red chilli powder, turmeric and Garam masala and cook for another 3-4 min.
7) Add water and let it come to a boil. Now add the methi and cook for 3-4 min. After this add the green peas and mix well. 
8) Add water and salt as per your desired consistency and taste.
9) Also add a little sugar. Now let the flame be on simmer and add milk and some fresh cream. Keep stirring so that it doesn’t separate.
10) Cook for 3 min and it is ready to eat😃

1) Boil green peas in salted water and drain the water.
2) In a pan boil sliced onions, chopped ginger and garlic. Once boiled and cool, add to blender.
3) Also add chopped tomatoes, cashew nuts, green chillies and blend till the whole mixture is smooth.
4) Heat oil in a pan and add cinnamon, cloves, cardamom.
5) Add the onion tomato paste and cook for 5-7 min.
6) Now add Kashmiri red chilli powder, turmeric and Garam masala and cook for another 3-4 min.
7) Add water and let it come to a boil. Now add the methi and cook for 3-4 min. After this add the green peas and mix well.
8) Add water and salt as per your desired consistency and taste.
9) Also add a little sugar. Now let the flame be on simmer and add milk and some fresh cream. Keep stirring so that it doesn’t separate.
10) Cook for 3 min and it is ready to eat😃
